name: Kors van Bennekombrug
en: Kors van Bennekombrug (bridge 2009) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. It lies in the Vennepluimstraat and connects the northern and southern parts of the Westelijk Haveneiland in IJburg, crossing the Groene Tunnel canal. The city contracted out the designs for bridges on and to IJburg at the time.

name: Kors van Bennekombrug
en: Kors van Bennekombrug (Bridge 2009) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge is located in the Vennepluimstraat and provides the connection between the northern and southern part of the Western Harbor Island in IJburg. It crosses the Groene Tunnel canal. The municipality contracted the designs for bridges on and to IJburg at the time

name: Korte Minrebroederstraat
en: The Korte Minrebroederstraat is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The Korte Minrebroederstraat runs from the Ganzenmarkt and Minrebroederstraat to the Oudkerkhof. The only side street of the Korte Minrebroederstraat is the Annastraat.

name: Korte Nieuwe Uitleg
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht in The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Korte Ouderkerkerbrug
en: The Korte Ouderkerkerbrug (bridge 1962) is a cycle and foot bridge in the Overamstel district on the right bank of the Amstel in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Duivendrechtsevaart, connecting the western part of the Korte Ouderkerkerdijk, just past the Zuidergasfabriekbrug (bridge 311) where the cycle path begins, with the Joan Muyskenweg.

name: Korte Ouderkerkerbrug
en: The Korte Ouderkerkerbrug (bridge 1962) is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge located in the Overamstel district on the right Amstel Riverbank in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Korte Prinsengracht
en: The Unicorn Lock (lock no. 103) is a lock in the Haarlemmerdijk between the Prinsengracht and the Korte Prinsengracht in Amsterdam. The lock and associated bridge Unicorn Lock (bridge no. 313) were planned as a connection of the then new canals with the IJ, since 1832 the Westerdok, when the canal belt was built. The name is derived from a later

name: Kortenoordsehaven
en: The Kortenoordsehaven is a dug harbor in Rotterdam Charlois, on the left bank of the Maas at kilometer 1004. The length is 360 meters, width 70 meters, depth NAP -4.50 meters. The harbor entrance is linked to that of the Barendrecht harbor. The harbor is accessible by land via the Sluisjesdijk.

name: Korzo Theater
en: Korzo is a theater and production company from The Hague. The theater and production company was founded in the early 1910s and organizes music and dance performances from Australia, Asia, Europe, North, South and Central America. It is the largest dance production company in the Netherlands.

name: Kostverlorenvaart
en: The Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West is the connection between the Schinkel and the IJ. Since the end of the 19th century, the connection with the IJ has been formed by the Kattensloot, Singelgracht and the Westerkanaal.

name: Koushaven
en: The Koushaven, dug in 1912 in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, was the last designed, but the first completed port in the Four Harbors area. The port owes its name to the Kous, a navigable ditch that in earlier times separated Delfshaven from the Ruigeplaat, which had formed in front of the Delfshaven harbor entrance in the Nieuwe Maas.

name: Kraan 2868
en: Kraan 2868, also called the Figeekraan, is a former harbour crane on KNSM-eiland in Amsterdam-Oost. It is a luffing crane, with a jib adjustable in height rather than fixed, and has been a municipal monument since 29 November 2011.

name: Kralingse Verlaat
en: The Kralingse Verlaat is a lock with pointed doors between the Hoge Boezem and the Kralingse Plas in the municipality of Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland. The waterway is CEMT class 0, access to the pond is almost exclusively important for pleasure boating.

name: Krattenbrug
en: The Krattenbrug is a fixed bridge over the Delftsevaart in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The original bridge probably existed since the fifteenth century and was one of the few structures that had survived the bombing on May 14, 1940. This bridge was both beloved and notorious; it was popular among photographers (the most famous being Henri Berssenb

name: Kreeksehaven
en: The Kreeksehaven is a section of an former drainage canal of the irrigation system of the island of IJsselmonde that flowed into the Zuiddiepje. Due to the construction of the A16 to Dordrecht, the connection with the pumping station was closed, and it had become an useless bay without flow, gradually becoming silted up for a large part. An aanta

name: Krijtbergbrug
en: The Krijtbergsluis (bridge no. 3) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the southwestern quay of the Singel and spans the Beulingsloot in the Amsterdam canal belt.

name: Krijtbergbrug
en: The Krijtbergsluis (bridge no. 3) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the south-western quay of the Singel and spans the Beulingsloot in Amsterdam's canal ring. A bridge has been here for centuries: Joan Blaeu's map of around 1649 already shows it, along with the buildings standing directly on the water at the Beulingsloot.

name: Kriterion
en: Film theater Kriterion, officially the Association for Mutual Student Support Kriterion (V.O.S.S. Kriterion), is a student-run cinema and student association at Roetersstraat 170 in Amsterdam. It emerged from the student resistance during World War II.

name: Kromme Nieuwegracht
en: The Kromme Nieuwegracht is a canal in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. Side streets of the Kromme Nieuwegracht are Ambachtstraat, Muntstraat, Pieterstraat, Nobeldwarsstraat and the Jeruzalemstraat. During excavations, Roman soil finds were found, which indicate that water already flowed here at the time when the Romans were in Utrecht

name: Krommerijnbrug
en: The Krommerijnbrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Kromme Rijn, which flows into the Stadsbuitengracht below. The Ledig Erf transitions onto the bridge into the Tolsteegsingel and the Abstederdijk. The bridge has two spans and is designed in stone with iron balustrades. In its current form, it was built in 1905

name: Kromwijkdreef
en: The Kromwijkdreef, part of urban route S113, connects Karspeldreef in the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost with Langbroekdreef and Loosdrechtdreef in Gaasperdam near the Gaasperpark.

name: Krugerplein
en: The Krugerplein is a square in the Transvaalbuurt in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Kruisvaart
en: Kruisvaart can refer to: Crusade (redirect page) crusade Kruisvaart (Cruquius), a watercourse near Cruquius pumping station Kruisvaart (Friesland), a sailing in the Dutch province of Friesland Kruisvaart (Utrecht), a watercourse in the Dutch city of Utrecht Kruisvaart (youth movement), a Catholic youth movement

name: Kruisvaart
en: The Kruisvaart is a waterway in the Dutch city of Utrecht that was formerly also known as Bloemgracht.

name: Kunstenaarsverzet
en: The Monument voor het kunstenaarsverzet 1940-1945 is an artistic work and memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The demolition of the Panoramagebouw at Plantage Middenlaan 50 left a relatively broad strip of green, which was named the Plantage Westermanlaan in 1963 and became a public garden without officially being called one.

name: Kunstliefde
en: The Kunstliefde society is an Utrecht association of artists and art lovers, founded in 1807. It is one of the oldest art societies in the Netherlands. At the two-hundredth anniversary in 2007, there were more than a hundred artists affiliated with the society. Kunstliefde is located at Nobelstraat in Utrecht.

name: KV Fiducia
en: KV Fiducia is a korfball club founded on March 22, 1963 in Vleuten. The club plays at "Sportpark Fletiomare-Oost" on the outskirts of Vleuterweide, part of the Vleuten-De Meern district in Utrecht.

name: L.H. Sarlouisbrug
en: The L.H. Sarlouisbrug (bridge 240) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge lies in the Weesperstraat and spans the Nieuwe Keizersgracht. Its history resembles that of the Dr. Dünnerbrug and the Dr. Meijer de Hondbrug, though it is somewhat older, given how the city developed outwards from the centre.

name: L.H. Sarlouisbrug
en: The L.H. Sarlouisbrug (bridge 240) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge is located in the Weesperstraat and spans the Nieuwe Keizersgracht. The bridge has a history similar to the Dr. Dünnerbrug and Dr. Meijer de Hondbrug, although it will be slightly older, due to the development of the city from the center. Older versions of the br

name: Laak
en: The Laak is an ancient peat river that runs through The Hague. Through the Laak, the water was discharged towards the Haagvliet. The Laakmolen and the Broekslootmolen were tasked with grinding the excess water in the Noordpolder into the Vliet's basin. The district around the peat stream is called Laakkwartier and Spoorwijk.

name: Laakhaven
en: The Laakhaven in The Hague was built in 1900 as a branch of the Haagvliet. Thus, the port is connected to the Vliet between Leiden and Delft. Part of the Laakhaven lies parallel to the Neherkade. The port developed into an important inland port, but that is over: partly the port serves as a transit port.

name: Laakkanaal
en: The Laakkanaal in The Hague (street name: Soestdijksekade, Troelstrakade) was dug in 1924 as a connection between the Loosduinsevaart and the Laakhaven in connection with the transport over water of horticultural products from the Westland. In 1932, the wholesale market for vegetables and fruit moved from the Veenkade to a site near the Laakkanaal.

name: Laaktheater
en: The Laaktheater is a list theater located on Ferrandweg in the Spoorwijk district in The Hague. The theater has a theater hall with 135 seats on a semicircular balcony, a large studio for dance lessons, among other things, and a small studio. Regular users are Laaks Youth Theater, Medea theater and Filmclub Laak.

name: Laan Copes van Cattenburch
en: The Laan Copes van Cattenburch is a busy, stately avenue in the Archipelbuurt neighborhood in The Hague. The avenue was laid out in 1870 and is named after mayor Lodewijk Constantijn Rabo Copes van Cattenburch and is part of the Centrumring around the Hague city center.

name: Laan op Zuid
en: The Laan op Zuid is a 2.5 km long avenue in the Rotterdam district of Feijenoord.

name: Laan van Spartaan
en: Laan van Spartaan is a residential neighborhood in the Amsterdam district of West, formerly district of Bos en Lommer. The neighborhood is bordered by the dike of the Ringspoorbaan in the west, Jan van Galenstraat in the south, the Ringweg (A10) in the east and the Erasmusgracht in the north.

name: Lage Erfbrug
en: The Lage Erfbrug is a steel bascule bridge over the Delfshavense Schie, in the district of Delfshaven in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The Lage Erfbrug lies along the Nieuwe Binnenweg. The bridge is passed by tram line 4. The Lage Erfbrug was built in 1926 when the Coolhaven was dug. Before the construction of the Coolhaven, the Delfs ended

name: Lamonggracht
en: The Lamonggracht is a canal with associated embankments in Amsterdam-Oost, classified under the Indian Quarter.

name: Landelijk monument spoorwegongevallen
en: The Landelijk monument spoorwegongevallen in Utrecht is located in Park Nieuweroord, near the NS main buildings, De Inktpot and Utrecht Central Station. The monument was designed and made by Anton Broos and was unveiled in 2004.

name: Landscheidingsweg
en: The S200 is a city route in The Hague that forms the northwest part of the Ring Road of The Hague.

name: Langbroekdreef
en: The Langbroekdreef is a dike in the subdistrict Nellestein in the Gaasperdam district in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. The dike is largely elevated in accordance with the starting points of the urban planning plan for the expansion that was then still called Zuid Bijlmer.

name: Lange Bretten
en: De Bretten, and sometimes also called the Lange Bretten, is a nature reserve in the Amsterdam municipality of Nieuw-West with an area of 130 ha. It is a green strip north of the Haarlemmertrekvaart and south of the Western Port Area on the polder lands of the Spieringhorner Binnenpolder. The area is named after the House at Bretten, one of

name: Lange Nieuwstraat
en: Lange Nieuwstraat can refer to: Lange Nieuwstraat (Antwerp), a street in Antwerp Lange Nieuwstraat (Nijmegen), a former street in Nijmegen Lange Nieuwstraat (Schiedam), a street in Schiedam Lange Nieuwstraat (Utrecht), a street in Utrecht Lange Nieuwstraat (IJmuiden), a street in IJmuiden

name: Lange Nieuwstraat
en: The Lange Nieuwstraat is a street in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

name: Lange Vliet
en: The Lange Vliet is a canal dug around 1385 in the province of Utrecht. This river running from south to north has a length of more than 3 km. The beginning of this river is in the Heicop polder south of the A12 motorway near De Meern, and its end is the confluence into the Leidse Rijn, close to the Meern Bridge. The Lange Vliet is located in the gemee

name: Langeweg
en: Langeweg is a village in the Dutch municipality of Moerdijk, province of North Brabant. The village has about 895 inhabitants and 258 houses and is the smallest core of the municipality of Moerdijk. The village of ten streets is surrounded by agricultural land on which arable farming and horticulture is carried out.

name: Lapjesmarkt
en: The Lapjesmarkt in Utrecht is a textile and stationery market. The market is held in the Breedstraat every Saturday from 8:00 am to 1:00 pm. During the coronavirus crisis in 2021, the patchwork market was canceled, while other Utrecht markets continued.

name: Lau Mazirelbrug
en: The Lau Mazirelbrug (bridge 259) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge was named in 1982 after lawyer and resistance fighter Lau Mazirel (1907-1974). The traffic bridge forms the connection between the quay of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht, the Nieuwe Kerkstraat and Roetersstraat from the southwest and the Plantage Kerklaan from the northeast.

name: Lau Mazirelbrug
en: The Lau Mazirelbrug (bridge 259) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum, named in 1982 after the lawyer and resistance fighter Lau Mazirel (1907-1974). The traffic bridge connects the quay of the Nieuwe Keizersgracht, the Nieuwe Kerkstraat and the Roetersstraat from the south-west with the Plantage Kerklaan from the north-east.

name: Laurenskerk
en: The Grote or Laurenskerk is a church building on Kerkstraat/Nieuwstraat in the center of the North Holland town of Weesp. The church was built between 1429 and 1462 as a late Gothic cruciform church, on the site where a Romanesque church had previously stood. From 1489, a seven-hour college was attached to the church with paid and professional singers.

name: Laurenskerk
en: The Grote or Laurenskerk is a church on the Kerkstraat and Nieuwstraat in the centre of Weesp, North Holland. It was built between 1429 and 1462 as a late Gothic cruciform church on the site of an earlier Romanesque church. From 1489 a college of seven canonical hours with paid professional singers was attached to it.

name: Le Mairegracht
en: The Le Mairegracht is a canal in the West district of Amsterdam. The name was established by council decision of November 20, 1878. The canal is named after Jacob le Maire (1585-1616), a explorer, who discovered the sea route named after him at the southern tip of South America. He named the cape after his birthplace Cape Horn. The Le Mairegra

name: Lee Millerbrug
en: The Lee Millerbrug (bridge 2080) is a bridge still to be built in Amsterdam-Oost. The bridge will be built in 2023 and 2024 and will provide the connection between Centrumeiland and Strandeiland within the IJburg district in Pampuslaan. The bridge will then span the Merdekagracht.

name: Lee Millerbrug
en: The Lee Millerbrug (bridge 2080) is a bridge still to be built in Amsterdam-Oost. It is being built in 2023 and 2024 and will carry the Pampuslaan between Centrumeiland and Strandeiland within the IJburg district, spanning the Merdekagracht. It was named on 6 July 2021 after the photographer and war correspondent Lee Miller.

name: Leeghwaterbrug
en: The Leeghwaterbrug is a bridge in The Hague, in the southern district of Laak. The bridge was named this in 1956 and was previously known as the "Slachthuisbrug" (Slaughterhouse Bridge). The road surface of the bridge is part of the Leeghwaterplein. The Hague tram lines 1, 16 and 17 run over the square and the bridge. The bridge spans the Laakhaven, a canal.

name: Leendert Benjamin Valk
en: The List of Stolpersteine in Hillegersberg-Schiebroek provides an overview of the commemorative stones placed in the city district of Hillegersberg-Schiebroek in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam as part of the Stolpersteine project of the German sculptor-artist Gunter Demnig. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of the National Socialism

name: Leeuwenputbrug
en: The Leeuwenputbrug (bridge 371) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-North. This traffic bridge is located in the Grasweg and spans the Buiksloterkanaal. On the east side of the canal, the Grasweg exits onto the Ranonkelkade. The first plans for a bridge on this site date back to 1916, when the land was leased to the Dordtsche Petroleum Maatschappij

name: Leeuwenputbrug
en: The Leeuwenputbrug (bridge 371) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. This traffic bridge lies in the Grasweg and spans the Buiksloterkanaal; on the east side of the canal the Grasweg meets the Ranonkelkade. The first plans for a bridge here date from 1916, when the site was leased to the Dordtsche Petroleum Maatschappij.

name: Leidsebosje
en: The Leidsebosje is a park between Leidseplein and Vondelpark in Amsterdam, in a north-south running strip between Stadhouderskade and Singelgracht in Amsterdam-West. On the north side it borders the Stadhouderskade 1 building, the former headquarters of Gemeentetram Amsterdam. In the south the park ends at the height of the Hein D

name: Leidsebrug
en: The Leidsebrug or Leidsepleinbrug, bridge no. 174, is a fixed slab bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum crossing the Singelgracht. It connects the Leidseplein and the Marnixstraat with the Leidsebosje and the Stadhouderkade, and is named after the former Leidsepoort. Its abutments and piers were made of natural stone.

name: Leidsebrug
en: The Leidsebrug or Leidsepleinbrug, bridge no. 174, is a fixed plate bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum and crosses the Singelgracht. The bridge connects Leidseplein and Marnixstraat with Leidsebosje and Stadhouderkade. The bridge is named after the former Leidsepoort. The landheads and pillars were made of natural stone. The bridge was embellished with an on

name: Leidseweg
en: Leidseweg can refer to: Leidseweg (Utrecht) Lombok/Leidseweg in Utrecht Leidseweg (Voorschoten)

name: Leidseweg
en: The Leidseweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It runs along the southern bank of the Leidse Rijn from Westplein to Kennedylaan.

name: Lekhaven
en: The Lekhaven is a pre-war harbor in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West. The Lekhaven was dug between 1912 and 1916 and designed for the transhipment of bulk goods. The most important company based in Lekhaven was Thomsen's Havenbedrijf, a company that combined the transhipment of bulk goods with the function of passenger terminal. On the east side

name: Lekstraatsynagoge
en: The Lekstraat Synagogue stands at Lekstraat 63 in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam. It is an important centre for the Haredi Jews living in Amsterdam and the surrounding area. Several hundred Haredim live in Amstelveen and Amsterdam, mainly in the Rivierenbuurt and Buitenveldert.

name: Lepelenburg
en: Lepelenburg is part of Zocherpark in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The street bordering this park area bears the same name. Originally, Lepelenburg was a house located here. In addition, a earthen fortification was built in the 16th century that served in the Utrecht city defense, but around 1860 it was transformed into a barracks.

name: Leuvehaven
en: The Leuvehaven is a port in Rotterdam located near the center of Rotterdam and the Erasmus Bridge. The port is used, among other things, as an outdoor museum for the Maritime Museum Rotterdam. The Leuvehaven has a direct connection to the Nieuwe Maas via a passage between the Mainland and the Boompjes.

name: Lex van Deldenbrug
en: The Lex van Deldenbrug (bridge 808) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is named after the composer Lex van Delden, other streets and squares in the area also received names that refer to composers. The bridge connects De Boelelaan with George Gershwinplein. It spans De Boelegracht, a canal that is located north of part of De Boelelaan

name: Lex van Deldenbrug
en: The Lex van Deldenbrug (bridge 808) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid, named after the composer Lex van Delden; other streets and squares nearby also refer to composers. It connects De Boelelaan with the George Gershwinplein, spanning De Boelegracht, a canal lying north of part of De Boelelaan.

name: Liefdesbruggetje
en: Het Liefdesbruggetje (bridge 172) is a bridge in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid. The footbridge is the easternmost of the three bridges in the Sarphatipark and spans the park's drainage system. Just before the bridge the water is pumped up out of a pond and then flows through an artificial channel and fall into the large pond.

name: Liefdesbruggetje
en: The Liefdesbruggetje (bridge 172) is a bridge in Amsterdam Oud-Zuid. The footbridge is the most easterly located of the three bridges in Sarphatipark. It spans the drainage system of the park. The water is pumped up from a pond just before the bridge; then the water flows through an artificial water channel/fall into the large pond. Through the fall

name: Lies Bakhuyzenlaan
en: Lies Bakhuyzenlaan is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Lijnbaan
en: The Lijnbaan is a short but important street in the center of The Hague. The street runs along the Buitenom and curves left into Loosduinseweg. It is an important route for public transport and the open space on the Prinsegracht, which was built in 1967-1968, curves right into the Lijnb

name: Lijnbaansbrug
en: The Lijnbaansbrug (bridge 10) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Lijnbaanssteeg with the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal, spanning the Singel. A bridge has been here for centuries: it is drawn on Pieter Bast's map of 1599, running from the Lijnbaan Steech to the Blaeuwe Burchwal.

name: Lijnbaansbrug
en: The Lijnbaansbrug (bridge 10) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects the Lijnbaanssteeg with the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal and spans the Singel. A bridge has been lying here for centuries. The bridge is drawn on Pieter Bast's map dating from 1599. That is where the bridge is located in the Lijnbaan Steech to the Blaeuwe Burchwal.

name: Lijnbaansgracht
en: The Lijnbaansgracht is a partially canalized canal in Amsterdam that curves along the border of the center. The canal runs parallel to the Singelgracht, between the Brouwersgracht and the Reguliersgracht. The canal was canalized between 1909-1914 around Leidseplein, between Passeerdersgracht and Leidsegracht.

name: Lijnderbrug
en: The Lijnderbrug is a lift bridge between the Amsterdamse Baan (T106) in Lijnden (Haarlemmermeer municipality) in the province of North Holland and the Ookmeerweg (s106) in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge spans, at more than 4 meters high, the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeerpolder and the Akerdijk, 500 meters southeast of the De Lynden Pump Station.

name: Lijnderbrug
en: The Lijnderbrug is a drawbridge between the Amsterdamse Baan (T106) in Lijnden, in the municipality of Haarlemmermeer, and the Ookmeerweg (s106) in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. At more than 4 metres above the water it spans the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeerpolder and the Akerdijk, 500 metres south-east of the De Lynden pumping station.

name: Linnaeusstraat
en: The Linnaeusstraat in Amsterdam-Oost runs between the Mauritskade and the Ringdijk, located around the Watergraafsmeer. The Middenweg runs along its extension. The Linnaeusstraat was named in 1878 after the famous natural researcher Carl Linnaeus (1707-1778).

name: Literatuurmuseum
en: The Literatuurmuseum, located in the Royal Library complex in The Hague, has been dedicated to authors from the Dutch-speaking area since 1750. Until November 1, 2016, the name was Nederlands Letterkundig Museum and Documentatiecentrum.

name: Living by Numbers
en: The HIV/AIDS monument is an artistic work on De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum, unveiled on 1 December 2016. The work by Jean-Michel Othoniel stands on De Ruijterkade. The initiative came around 2013 from the Stichting Namen Project Nederland, which asked a number of artists for a monument.

name: Living by Numbers
en: The HIV/AIDS monument is an artistic work of art on De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum that was unveiled on December 1, 2016. The creation of Jean-Michel Othoniel is located on De Ruijterkade, Amsterdam. The initiative for the monument came around 2013 from Stichting Namen Project Nederland, which asked a number of artists to create a monument.

name: LJG
en: The Liberal Jewish Congregation of Amsterdam (LJG) is the local community of liberal Jews in Amsterdam and its surroundings, with a synagogue in Amsterdam-Zuid since 1957. Since 2010 the LJG has had a new synagogue and cultural centre on the Zuidelijke Wandelweg, near the Gaasterlandstraat.

name: LJG
en: The Liberal Jewish Community of Amsterdam (LJG) is the local community of the liberal Jews in the Dutch city of Amsterdam and its surroundings, with (since 1957) a synagogue in Amsterdam-Zuid. Since 2010, the LJG has had a new synagogue with cultural center on the Zuidelijke Wandelweg, near the Gaasterlandstraat.

name: Lodewijk Pincoffsbrug
en: The Lodewijk Pincoffsbrug is a lift bridge in the Feijenoord district of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The bridge spans the Binnenhaven and is part of the Lodewijk Pincoffsweg, both named after the Rotterdam businessman Lodewijk Pincoffs, whose Rotterdamse Handelsvereeniging in the last quarter of the 19th century developed the ports in Feijenoord.

name: Lodewijk van Deysselstraat
en: The Maria Woesthovenbrug (bridge 620) is a fixed bridge in Geuzenveld-Slotermeer, Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Lodewijk van Deysselstraat and spans an unnamed canal. It dates from around 1955, when the district was built, and was designed by the Dienst der Publieke Werken.

name: Londenhaven
en: The Londenhaven is a port in the east of the Europoort area in Rotterdam, at the end of the Caland Canal, next to the Britannia Port. The port is located close to the Rozenburg lock.

name: Long Walk to Freedom
en: Long Walk to Freedom is a statue in The Hague. It was unveiled on September 25, 2012 by Nobel Peace Prize winner and Archbishop Emeritus Desmond Tutu.

name: Loosduins Museum "De Korenschuur"
en: The Loosduins Museum in The Hague is a museum that focuses on the cultural heritage of the Loosduinen district, which dates back to the twelfth century, when Floris III of Holland founded a manor house there. From 1811 to 1923, Loosduinen was an independent municipality.

name: Loosduinsekade
en: The Loosduinsevaart in The Hague was dug in 1645, after the completion of the Hague canal belt, and became an important waterway between The Hague and the Westland. Prince Frederick Henry also sailed over the Loosduinsevaart when he went to his country house in Honselersdijk.

name: Loosduinsevaart
en: The Loosduinsevaart in The Hague was dug in 1645, after the completion of the Hague canal belt, and became an important waterway between The Hague and the Westland. Prince Frederick Henry also sailed over the Loosduinsevaart when he went to his country house in Honselersdijk.

name: Louis Hartloopercomplex
en: The Louis Hartlooper Complex (LHC) is a movie theater, cultural center and catering establishment in the city of Utrecht in the Netherlands. The theater opened its doors in 2004.

name: Louis Hartog Frijda
en: The list of Stolpersteine in Utrecht (municipality) gives an overview of the commemorative stones that have been placed in the municipality of Utrecht in the Dutch province of Utrecht as part of the Stolpersteine project of the German sculptor-artist Gunter Demnig. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were murdered by it.

name: Lourdeskapel
en: The Lourdeskapel in Scheveningen is part of the urban complex listed in the register of national monuments that is also called 'the church village'. The chapel dates back to 1913 and is located on Berkenbosch Blokstraat. The Lourdeskapel with Lourdes grotto stands in front of the O.L. Vrouw van Lourdes church, which was closed in 2005.

name: Lozerlaan
en: The Lozerlaan is a lane in the southwest of The Hague. The meaning of the name Lozerlaan is unknown, although there is probably a relationship with the name Loosduinen. The name itself is hundreds of years old and appears on Hague maps from around 1600.

name: Lozingskanaal
en: The Lozingskanaal is a straight waterway in Amsterdam, which lies in the eastern extension of the Singelgracht and runs to the Zeeburg Pump Station.

name: Lucas Jansz Sinckbrug
en: The Lucas Jansz Sinckbrug (bridge no. 36) is a bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum in the canal belt. It is located on the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Keizersgracht. It is therefore the last bridge over the Keizersgracht, which ends here. On the other side of the Amstel, the Nieuwe Keizersgracht was dug, which also begins with a bridge, the

name: Lucas Jansz Sinckbrug
en: The Lucas Jansz Sinckbrug (bridge no. 36) is a bridge in the canal ring of Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Amstel and spans the Keizersgracht, making it the last bridge over that canal, which ends here. Across the Amstel the Nieuwe Keizersgracht was dug, and it too begins with a bridge.

name: Lucasbrug
en: The Lucasbrug is a fixed bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is located on the east side of the city center near the Lucasfort. The bridge forms in particular a direct connection between Nobelstraat and Nachtegaalstraat. The waterway it crosses there is the Stadsbuitengracht. This former defensive moat around the city was from

name: Luchtwachttoren 5C1
en: Luchtwachttoren 5C1 is a watchtower in the sea wall on the Zwartepad in the Oostduinen district in Scheveningen, in the dunes north of Scheveningen, which are known as Oostduinen. During the Cold War, 279 air defense towers were built in the Netherlands. For half of them, existing buildings were used, but 140 towers were also newly built.

name: Luther Museum Amsterdam
en: The Luther Museum Amsterdam, formerly known as the Luther Collection Amsterdam, is a museum that wants to introduce the public to Lutheranism in the Netherlands and Amsterdam, the role of Wittenberg as a center of administration and the works of the diaconate in the past and present, with a collection of art and historical objects related to Lutheranism.

name: Lutkemeerpark
en: The Lutkemeerpark is the unofficial name of a park in the west of the Lutkemeerpolder.

name: Lyceumbrug
en: The Lyceumbrug (bridge 410) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It connects Olympiaplein with Pieter Lastmankade and Jan van Goyenkade, the northern quays of the Noorder Amstel Canal. It forms a structural unit with Het Amsterdams Lyceum (which used to stand there and is named after it) and the Monument Indië-Nederland, on the other side. in

name: Lyceumbrug
en: The Lyceumbrug (bridge 410) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It connects the Olympiaplein with the Pieter Lastmankade and the Jan van Goyenkade, the northern quays of the Noorder Amstelkanaal. It forms an architectural whole with Het Amsterdams Lyceum, which stood there first and gave it its name, and with the Monument Indië-Nederland opposite.

name: M. Justbrug
en: The M. Justbrug (bridge 803) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. The bridge is located in Van Nijenrodeweg in Buitenveldert. It spans a water that runs parallel to Van der Boechorststraat. The approximately 35 meters wide traffic bridge dates back to 1961.

name: M. Justbrug
en: The M. Justbrug (bridge 803) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies in the Van Nijenrodeweg in Buitenveldert and spans a watercourse running parallel to the Van der Boechorststraat. The roughly 35-metre-wide traffic bridge dates from 1961 and is a culvert bridge, carried over a four-metre concrete box culvert.

name: M.S. Vaz Diasbrug
en: The M.S. Vaz Diasbrug (bridge 238), is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge connects Jonas Daniel Meijerplein with Weesperstraat. It spans the Nieuwe Herengracht. The history of the bridge is similar to the L.H. Sarlouisbrug, Dr. Dünnerbrug and Dr. Meijer de Hondbrug in Weesperstraat. The bridges were constantly undergoing renovations

name: M.S. Vaz Diasbrug
en: The M.S. Vaz Diasbrug (bridge 238) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Jonas Daniël Meijerplein with the Weesperstraat, spanning the Nieuwe Herengracht. Its history resembles that of the L.H. Sarlouisbrug, Dr. Dünnerbrug and Dr. Meijer de Hondbrug in the Weesperstraat, all constantly rebuilt and renewed.

name: Maarssenbroeksedijk
en: The Maarssenbroeksedijk is a street in the Dutch municipalities of Utrecht and Stichtse Vecht.

name: Maarten Lutherkerk
en: The Maarten Luther Kerk is a church building in the Rivierenbuurt in Amsterdam-Zuid. It was designed for the Evangelical Lutheran church in the Amsterdam School style by the architect F. Jantzen.

name: Maartensbrug
en: The Maartensbrug is a bridge located over the Oudegracht and a national monument in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The stone Maartensbrug, which today connects Zadelstraat and Servetstraat, is named after Saint Martin, the patron saint of the Cathedral and of the city of Utrecht. The arched bridge consists of two spans.

name: Maasboulevard
en: The Maasboulevard is the main eastern access road to the center of Rotterdam in the Dutch province of South Holland. From the Boerengat Bridge, the road is part of the center ring S100, before that of the S107.

name: Maashaven
en: The Maashaven is one of the ports of Rotterdam.

name: Maaskade
en: The Maaskade is a street on the North Island, part of the district of Feijenoord in Rotterdam-Zuid. Since 2008, all houses on the Maaskade fall under the protected cityscape of Noordereiland. On the Maaskade is located, among other things, the Hulstkamp building, one of the 518 national monuments of Rotterdam.

name: Maasmond
en: The Rhine Delta in the Netherlands is the area formed by the various (also former) branches of the Rhine, starting at the border between the Netherlands and Germany and continuing towards the North Sea. Within the Rhine Delta is also part of the watershed of the Maas. The watersheds of the Maas and Rhine did not only coincide when the Maas and the Rhine

name: Maastunnelplein
en: The Maastunnelplein is a busy traffic square in the Rotterdam municipality of Charlois. The square is directly connected to the tourist entrance south of the Maas Tunnel. If you drive onto the square from the tunnel, you can choose from four directions. Village road, Square road, Doklaan or Brielselaan.

name: Machineslootbrug
en: The Machineslootbrug (bridge 358) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Admiralengracht.

name: Madagascarhaven
en: The Madagascarhaven is a port in the Amsterdam Western Port Area just north and east of the artists' village Ruigoord and west of the Accraweg. On the south side, the port borders the Afrikahaven, which was dug and ready at the same time in 2001. The Madagascarhaven is a southern side port of the Afrikahaven and is five meters deep

name: Madestein

It came about thanks to the Stichting Standbeeld Mahatma Gandhi, mainly made up of Indian and Surinamese supporters of Gandhi's ideas, who had been working since around 1972 to have a statue of him erected.

name: Majanggracht

Along multiple sides of the park runs a street under the same name, on the south side is the Vleutenseweg.

A bridge has been here for centuries: one appears on Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode's map of 1625, and there was probably one earlier still.

The Valkenbos Church was opened in 1929 as a Reformed church and had approximately 1000 seats. In 2011, the Valkenbos Church underwent major renovations.

name: Margaret Bourke-Whitebrug
en: The Margaret Bourke-Whitebrug (Amsterdam bridge number 2030) is a structure in Amsterdam-Oost. It was built between 2018 and 2021 to connect Haveneiland with Centrumeiland in IJburg. It is one of the so-called outer-water bridges in a series of fixed bridges designed by the architects Benthem Crouwel.

name: Margaret Bourke-Whitebrug

The bridge was built between 2018 and 2021 and was built to connect the Haveneiland and the Centrumeiland in IJburg. It is one of the so-called outer water bridges in a series of fixed bridges designed by architectural firm Benthem Crouwel.

name: Mariahoek
en: The Mariahoek is an inner square that borders the Mariaplaats in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. From the rear of the houses on the right of the Mariaplaats, you look out over the Willemsplansoen. Numerous national monuments are located on the Mariahoek.

name: Mariaplaats
en: The Mariaplaats is a square in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is named after the missing Mariakerk. Around it was a large square, part of which is still present north and east of the former church and together form the Mariaplaats.

name: Marinehaven
en: A naval harbour is a seaport the armed forces use to station warships or submarines. Each naval vessel has its own home port. Such harbours are tightly guarded, because ammunition for the ships is stored there and because of the risk of attack or terrorism. They usually also have administrative buildings.

name: Mariniersbrug
en: The Mariniersbrug is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum, bridge number 272. The traffic bridge lies in line with the Kattenburgerstraat (S116) and spans the Dijksgracht. North of it the Kattenburgerstraat dips under the Kattenburgerspoorbrug towards the junction with the Piet Heinkade. The bridge is named after the nearby marine barracks.

name: Mariniersweg
en: The Mariniersweg is a shopping street in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam, which runs from the Vondelweg and the Goudsesingel to the Burgemeester van Walsumweg and the Blaak. Side streets of the Mariniersweg are the Bredestraat, Vogelzang, Mariniershof, Pannekoekstraat, Hoogstraat, Rijstuin and the Groenendaal.

name: Marnixbrug
en: The Marnixbrug in the Dutch city of Utrecht is a high fixed bridge with four lanes that connects the Marnixlaan with the Einsteindreef and thus connects the Overvecht district with the Zuilen district. The bridge was built in 1965-1967, at the same time as the new Overvecht district was built. The eastern headland contains a shelter for 200 people.

name: Marten Toonderbrug
en: The Marten Toonderbrug (bridge 48) is a masonry vaulted bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge forms the connection between Wolvenstraat and Berenstraat and spans the Keizersgracht there. There was already a bridge here for centuries. The bridge that was there in 1902 had to deal with defects due to the amount of traffic going over it.

name: Marten Toonderbrug
en: The Marten Toonderbrug (bridge 48) is a brick arched bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Wolvenstraat with the Berenstraat, spanning the Keizersgracht. A bridge has been here for centuries; the one standing in 1902 suffered from the volume of traffic crossing it, and its rotted wooden beams had to be replaced.

name: Martin Luther King

name: Martin Luther Kingpark

The Mathenesserbrug connects Mathenesserplein in the Nieuwe Westen with Mathenesserdijk, Mathenesserweg and Grote Visserijstraat in Bospolder/Tussendijken. The bridge is passed by tram lines 1, 7 and 11.

name: Mattheuskerk
en: The Mattheüskerk is a Protestant church building on Hendrika van Tussenbroeklaan in the Oog in Al district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church building was built in 1952 according to a design by father and son Gijs and Teus van Hoogevest. The church was originally Dutch Reformed, but has been Christian Reformed since 1996.

The street is part of a series of three embankments: the Mauritskade, the Stadhouderskade and the Nassaukade that together with the S100 form the outer ring along the banks of the Singelgracht.

name: Mauritspoort
en: The Mauritspoort or Grenadier Gate is the eastern entrance to the Binnenhof in The Hague. The gate was built in 1634 together with the nearby Binnenpoort and had a drawbridge over an inner moat at the time. The pulley holes are still visible on the outside. name: Max Euwe Centrum
en: The Max Euwe Centrum is a chess centre on the Max Euweplein in Amsterdam. It consists of a small museum about the chess career and life of the Dutch world champion Max Euwe (1901-1981) and a meeting centre and library with around eleven thousand books and periodicals.

name: Máximapark
en: The Máximapark is a city park, located in the west of the Dutch municipality of Utrecht. The park is named after Princess, later Queen Máxima. It forms the green central heart of the large urban expansion of Utrecht west of the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal, which began in the second half of the 1990s. This area had approximately 18,000 inhabitants in 1995.

Meervaart connects the neighborhood, the city and the wider world with each other.

name: Monument Walraven van Hall
en: The Monument Walraven van Hall is an artwork and war memorial in Amsterdam-Centrum. The sculpture was initiated by the retired general practitioner Hans Weijers and the retired physician Loek van Buchem, who set up a foundation to raise a monument to the resistance member Walraven van Hall.

name: Mor Sharbil
en: The building at Burgemeester Eliasstraat 72-74 in Amsterdam-Slotermeer has been a municipal monument since 2011. A new Sint-Catharinakerk went up on this spot in 1954, after the old church was demolished in 1939. It was built to a design by the architects Evers en Sarlemijn, who put the work out to tender in July 1954.

name: Mor Sharbil
en: The building Burgemeester Eliasstraat 72-74 in Amsterdam-Slotermeer Amsterdam has been a municipal monument since 2011. In 1954, a new Sint-Catharinakerk was built on this site, after the old church was demolished in 1939. The church was completed in a design by the architectural firm Evers and Sarlemijn, which carried out the tender in July 1954.

name: Moreelsepark
en: The Moreelsepark is a park with a corresponding street in the city of Utrecht. The park is named after Hendrick Moreelse and is located on Catharijnesingel, opposite the Hooch Boulandt neighborhood. Before 1870, the area was part of the Nieuweroord park.

name: Moskee El-Hijra
en: The Olive Branch was built in 1956 as a Baptist church on Arthur van Schendelstraat in the garden city of Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The building from the reconstruction period is characteristic of the work of architect Karel Sijmons.

name: Moskee El-Hijra
en: De Olijftak was built in 1956 as a Mennonite church on the Arthur van Schendelstraat in the garden city of Slotermeer in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The post-war building is characteristic of the work of the architect Karel Sijmons. It went out of use as a Mennonite church in 1969 and was then sold to the Reformed Church.

name: Motion Church
en: The Marcus Church is a monumental church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is located near Hoograven. It was built in 1958 for the Dutch Reformed Church to the design of J.B. baron van Asbeck. The building is valued as a municipal monument. In 2018, the Dutch Reformed Church held its last service there.

name: Muiderbergbrug
en: The Muiderbergbrug (bridge 989) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The foot and cycle bridge lies in line with the Markengouw in Nieuwendam. It dates from 1968/1969 and is built of concrete — span, piers and abutments — with steel balustrades painted blue, a colour found on several structures in this neighbourhood.

name: Muiderbergbrug
en: The Muiderbergbrug (bridge 989) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-North. The foot and bicycle bridge is along the Markengouw in Nieuwendam. The bridge dates back to 1968/1969 and consists of concrete (a concrete span, concrete pillars, concrete abutments) with blue painted steel balustrades. This color is more common in this area. name: Muiderkerk
en: The Muiderkerk is a Protestant church on Linnaeusstraat in Amsterdam-Oost, on the edge of Oosterpark. The old Muiderkerk, built in 1892, partially burned down in 1989 but the distinctive tower remained unscathed. The current Muiderkerk is built against the old tower and is part of a 1997 construction complex designed by architect Van Hoogeve

name: Muiderpoort
en: The Muiderpoort in Amsterdam is a city gate on the Alexanderplein, at the crossing of the Plantage Middenlaan with the Sarphatistraat. The gate was part of Amsterdam's fortifications. On either side lie bridge 264, over the Plantage Muidergracht by Artis, and bridge 265, over the Singelgracht to the Tropenmuseum on the Mauritskade.

name: Muiderpoort
en: The Muiderpoort in Amsterdam is a city gate on Alexanderplein, at the intersection of Plantage Middenlaan and Sarphatistraat. The gate was part of the fortifications of Amsterdam. On either side of the gate are bridge 264 (over the Plantage Muidergracht near Artis) and bridge 265 (over the Singelgracht to Het Tropenmuseum on the Mauritskade).

name: Muiderspoorbrug
en: The Muiderspoorbrug bridge between Diemen and Weesp spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Amsterdam-Zutphen railway line and since 1993 also of the Weesp-Leiden railway line. The first railway bridge at this location was built in 1892 when the Merwedekanaal was constructed. This later merged into the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal.

name: Muiderspoorbrug
en: The Muiderspoorbrug between Diemen and Weesp crosses the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal and forms part of the Amsterdam-Zutphen railway and, since 1993, of the Weesp-Leiden railway as well. The first railway bridge here was built in 1892 when the Merwedekanaal was dug; that canal was later absorbed into the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal.

name: Muntbrug
en: The Muntbrug in the Merwedekanaal is a swing bridge from 1887 in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It has been a national monument since 2002. The bridge was built in 1887, during the construction of the Merwedekanaal, on the southeast bank of the Leidsche Rijn; the Leidseweg runs over it and the Kanaalweg and Muntkade lie on the banks.

name: Muntsluis
en: The Muntsluis (bridge no. 1) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Although it carries number 1, it is not the first bridge of Amsterdam. The word sluis is used here in the sense of a stone bridge, not a water barrier. It crosses the point where the Singel flows into the Amstel, connecting the east quay of the Singel with the far side.

name: Muntsluis
en: The Muntsluis is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Although the bridge bears the number 1, it is not the first bridge of Amsterdam. The name sluice is used here in the meaning of "stone bridge", not as a water dam.

name: Muntsluis
en: The Muntsluis (bridge no. 1) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Although the bridge bears the name number 1, it is not the first bridge of Amsterdam. The name sluice is used here in the meaning of "stone bridge", not as a water dam. The bridge is located over the place where the Singel flows into the Amstel.

name: Museum Amsterdam Noord
en: Museum Amsterdam Noord is a Dutch cultural history museum on the corner of Zamenhofstraat and Meeuwenlaan in Amsterdam-North. The museum has been located in the 1919 building of the bathhouse in Vogeldorp since April 2009. The houses in this garden village did not have a bathroom and so a bathhouse was necessary. name: Museum Amsterdam Noord
en: Museum Amsterdam Noord is a cultural history museum on the corner of the Zamenhofstraat and the Meeuwenlaan in Amsterdam-Noord. Since April 2009 it has occupied the bathhouse built in 1919 for Vogeldorp; the houses in that garden village had no bathrooms, so a bathhouse was necessary.

name: Museum De Dageraad
en: De Dageraad is a housing complex in Amsterdam-Zuid. It lies on both sides of the P.L. Takstraat and is among the aesthetic high points of the Amsterdam School. In 1920 the socialist housing association De Dageraad commissioned the architects Michel de Klerk and Piet Kramer to build 294 homes and six shops.

name: Museum De Dageraad
en: De Dageraad is a residential complex in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is located on either side of the P.L. Takstraat and is one of the aesthetic highlights of the Amsterdam School. name: Museum of the Canals
en: Grachtenmuseum Amsterdam, the Museum of the Canals, is a museum on the Herengracht in Amsterdam devoted to the 17th-century Amsterdam canal ring and the history of the city. It occupies a seventeenth-century canal house with classical period rooms, a permanent multimedia exhibition, a canal garden and temporary exhibitions.

name: Museum of the Canals
en: Grachtenmuseum Amsterdam (Museum of the Canals) is a museum on the Herengracht in Amsterdam dedicated to the 17th-century Amsterdam canal belt and the history of Amsterdam. name: Museum Sophiahof
en: Museum Sophiahof (officially: National Museum Sophiahof) is a museum, knowledge and community center, dedicated to the cultural and historical heritage of Dutch East Indies and the Moluccans and their significance in post-war the Netherlands and the present day. The Sophiahof opened in 2019 and is located in The Hague. The museum is managed by the Stichting

name: Museum Weesp
en: Museum Weesp is located on the second floor of the Weesp Town Hall in the Dutch province of North Holland. It highlights the history of Weesp, whose history is related to porcelain, cocoa and bicycles. The museum began in 1911 as an antiquities room within the town hall. In 1974 this was turned into a museum after a donation of porcelain, which was sold

name: Museum Weesp
en: Museum Weesp is on the second floor of the town hall of Weesp in the province of North Holland. It covers the history of Weesp, which is bound up with porcelain, cocoa and bicycles. The museum began in 1911 as an antiquities room within the town hall, and became a museum in 1974 after a gift of porcelain.

name: Museumbrug
en: The Museumbrug is a bridge over the Biltsche Grift in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is a fixed bridge with a very limited clearance height. The bridge already existed in 1906 and it is located at the junction of Museumlaan and Biltstraat. The bridge has been adapted over time. A bridge railing from the 1930s runs along the Biltsche Grift over a distance

name: Muurschildering Johan Cruijff
en: The Johan Cruijff mural is a wall painting in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer. The portrait of Johan Cruijff was painted in 2017 on the side wall of a block of flats on the Anfieldroad, at right angles to the Wembleylaan. Those streets were laid out on the grounds of the former AFC Ajax ground Stadion De Meer.

name: Muurschildering Johan Cruijff
en: The Muurschildering Johan Cruijff is a mural in Amsterdam-Watergraafsmeer. The portrait of Johan Cruyff was installed in 2017 on the side facade of a residential apartment building, which is located on Anfieldroad, perpendicular to Wembleylaan. Those streets were laid out on the grounds of the former AFC Ajax stadium Stadion De Meer.

name: Muzee Scheveningen
en: Muzee Scheveningen is a cultural and natural history museum in the Dutch seaside resort of Scheveningen, a district of The Hague, that brings the history, culture and daily life of that place into focus, especially in relation to the sea and fishing. The museum attracted 30,000 visitors in 2011, in 2017 there were more than 40,000.

name: Naardermeer
en: The Naardermeer is a protected nature reserve on the northwestern border of the Gooi, located between Muiderberg, Naarden, Hilversumse Meent and Weesp, in the merged municipality of Gooise Meren. The local population has long spoken of the Naardermeer (from the Naardermeer drainage works or the Naardermeerpolder). It is a pond area with reeds, hay

name: NACO-house
en: The office of Koppe's Scheepsagentuur, also known as the NACO-huisje, is a former shipping office on De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was designated a national monument in 2002 for its combination of the Amsterdam School with a foreign building style, particularly in the roof. Since 13 December 2021 it has stood by bridge 2274 over the Oostertoegang.

name: NACO-house
en: The Office of Koppe's Shipping Agency, also known as the NACO cottage, is a former shipping office on the De Ruijterkade in Amsterdam-Centrum. It was designated as a national monument in 2002 due to the combination of Amsterdam School and an exotic architectural style, especially in the chapel.

name: Nassaubrug
en: The Nassaubrug is a lift bridge in the Feijenoord district of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The bridge connects Roentgenstraat with Nijverheidstraat. The Nassaubrug connects both sides of the Nassauhaven. The original bridge dates back to around 1892 and had two falls.

name: Nassauhaven
en: The Nassauhaven is a port in Rotterdam located in the district of Feijenoord. It was dug between 1890 and 1892 and was intended for factories that had to be located on navigable waters and needed a rail connection. name: Nassaukade
en: The Nassaukade is a street in Rotterdam in the Feijenoord district. The street begins near the Nassaubrug along the Nassauhaven, and eventually merges into the Stieltjesstraat.

name: Nassaukade
en: The Nassaukade is a street in Amsterdam-West, on the banks of the Singelgracht, between Nassauplein and the Overtoom.

name: Nassaukerk
en: The Nassaukerk is a Protestant church of 1926 on the De Wittenkade in the Staatsliedenbuurt in Amsterdam-West.

name: Nassauplein
en: The Nassauplein in Amsterdam is a square in Amsterdam-West.

name: Nationaal monument Slavernijverleden
en: The Nationaal Monument Slavernijverleden is a monument in the Oosterpark in Amsterdam to commemorate the abolition of slavery in the Dutch Kingdom. The statue is made of bronze and the base is made of concrete.

name: Nationaal Monument voor de Koninklijke Marine
en: The Nationaal Monument voor de Koninklijke Marine is located on the Seawall in Scheveningen. The monument was unveiled on June 14, 1966 and commemorates the naval victims of World War II. It is an abstract tuff stone sculpture standing on a platform of stones. It was made by Mari S. Andriessen (1897-1979). On the base is a quote from

name: Nationaal Onafhankelijkheidsmonument
en: The Nationaal Monument on Plein 1813 in The Hague was unveiled in 1869 to commemorate the victory over Napoleon, the end of the French era in the Netherlands, independence and the founding in 1813 of the Sovereign Principality of the United Provinces, the precursor to the United Kingdom of the Netherlands and the current Kingdom of the Netherlands

name: Natuurpark Bloeyendael
en: Natuurpark Bloeyendael is a park and former estate in the Utrecht neighborhood of Rijnsweerd in the Oost district. The country house was created between 1628 and 1660 by the renovation of the inn 'De Grote Biesbosch'. The area was then called Biesfelt. In 1290, the Biltse Street Road was built through this area. Between 1628 and 1660 it grew east of this h

name: Natuurpark Vrije Geer
en: The Natuurpark Vrije Geer is a small green area near the village of Sloten with an area of more than 4 hectares. It is located between the Plesmanlaan, the Nieuw Sloten district and the village of Sloten. It is a last remnant of the peat meadow area that formerly stretched between Amsterdam and Sloten.

name: Neckarhaven
en: The Neckarhaven is a port in the east of the Europoort area in Rotterdam on the Hartel Canal. The port is located near the Caland Bridge and the Harmsen Bridge.

name: Nedereindse Plas
en: The Nedereindse Plas is a recreational area in the province of Utrecht in the Netherlands, near Nieuwegein. The pond was created by the extraction of sand for the construction of motorway A2 and the new residential areas of Nieuwegein. The area is located in the Rijnenburg polder, which is part of the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Nedereindseweg
en: The Nedereindseweg is a road about six kilometers long, running from east to west and at the end to northwest in the Dutch municipalities of Nieuwegein and Utrecht. Originally, the beginning of this road was near the Vaartsche Rijn. A short section of this road near the Vaartsche Rijn is now called Het Sluisje.

name: Nelson Mandelapark
en: The Nelson Mandelapark, formerly known as Bijlmerpark until 2014, is a city park in the south of the Bijlmermeer in Amsterdam-Zuidoost. Bijlmerpark was originally laid out in 1969 and 1970. Since 1975, the Kwakoe Summer Festival has been organized here annually.

name: Neude
en: The Neude is a square in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht.

name: Nicolaas Beetsstraat
en: The Hennetjesbrug (bridge 179) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. It lies in the Nicolaas Beetsstraat and spans the Jacob van Lennepkanaal. The former grounds of the Wilhelmina Gasthuis lay to its south-east. A drawbridge for traffic opened here in May 1889, designed by Bastiaan de Greef, the city architect.

name: Nicolaïkerk
en: The Nicolaïkerk is a church in the Dutch city of Utrecht, located at Nicolaaskerkhof 8. In popular parlance, the church is also known as the Nicolaaskerk or the Klaaskerk, not to be confused with the Sint-Nicolaaskerk. It is in use by the Protestant Church in the Netherlands.

name: Nicolaïkerk
en: The Nicolaïkerk is a church in the Dutch city of Utrecht, located at Nicolaaskerkhof 8. In popular parlance, the church is also known as the Nicolaaskerk or the Klaaskerk, not to be confused with the Sint-Nicolaaskerk. It is in use by the Protestant Church in the Netherlands.

name: Nieuwe Amstelbrug
en: The Nieuwe Amstelbrug (bridge no. 101) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge over the Amstel on the border between De Pijp in Amsterdam-South and Amsterdam-East. The bridge forms the river crossing between the Ceintuurbaan and Amsteldijk (formerly Utrechtsezijde) on the one hand and Weesperzijde, Ruyschstraat and Eerste Oosterparkstraat on the other.

name: Nieuwe Amstelbrug
en: The Nieuwe Amstelbrug (bridge no. 101) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge over the Amstel on the boundary between De Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid and Amsterdam-Oost. It links the Ceintuurbaan and Amsteldijk, formerly Utrechtsezijde, with the Weesperzijde, Ruyschstraat and Eerste Oosterparkstraat.

name: Nieuwe Badkapel
en: The Nieuwe Badkapel is a church of the Protestant church in Scheveningen. The building at the corner of Nieuwe Duinweg and Nieuwe Parklaan in The Hague is a national monument.

name: Nieuwe Diep
en: The Nieuwe Diep is a lake in Amsterdam-Oost, between the IJ and the Watergraafsmeer.

name: Nieuwe Doelenstraat
en: The Nieuwe Doelenstraat is a street in the city center of Amsterdam. The street runs along the Kloveniersburgwal and runs from the corner with Staalstraat in a southwest direction to the Oude Turfmarkt, where the Doelensluis crosses the Rokin. This street was home to the Kloveniersdoelen, where The Night Watch was originally hung. The street is empty

name: Nieuwe Hemweg
en: The Hemweg in the Western Harbor Area of Amsterdam was named in 1938 and was named after the former promontory the Hem in the former IJ, south of Zaandam. The word is the same as 'ham', which is only known as 'inham' anymore.

name: Nieuwe Houtenseweg
en: Viaduct Nieuwe Houtenseweg is a viaduct located over the A27 national highway between junction Rijnsweerd and junction Lunetten in Utrecht. The 141-meter-long traffic bridge forms a connection with the existing Nieuwe Houtenseweg, one side of which begins at the Oude Mereveldseweg and ends at the Furkabaan in the Lunetten district.

name: Nieuwe Houtenseweg
en: Viaduct Nieuwe Houtenseweg is a viaduct located over the A27 national highway between junction Rijnsweerd and junction Lunetten in Utrecht. The 141-meter-long traffic bridge forms a connection with the existing Nieuwe Houtenseweg, one side of which begins at the Oude Mereveldseweg and ends at the Furkabaan in the Lunetten district.

name: Nieuwe Houtenseweg
en: The Nieuwe Houtenseweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht in the Lunetten subdistrict. The approximately 1100-meter-long street runs from the Furkabaan and Furkaplateau to the Oude Mereveldseweg near the A12 that crosses the street over a viaduct. The only side street is the Zwartewoud. The Nieuwe Houtenseweg houses several care facilities such as

name: Nieuwe Houthaven
en: The Houthavens are a group of harbors along the IJ in the Western Harbor Area of Amsterdam. On the north side, the harbors are bordered by the breakwater in the IJ, on the south side by the Spaarndammerbuurt. The harbors are mainly used by inland shipping. On the southern shores of the Houthavens were wood storage sites and companies in the wood industry

name: Nieuwe Kerk
en: The Nieuwe Kerk is a church in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It was the first church in Utrecht to be built specifically as a Reformed church, hence the name "New" church. name: Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg
en: The Nieuwe Leeuwarderweg is a motorway that lies partly parallel to the North Holland Canal in Amsterdam-Noord. It is a motorway with a maximum speed of 70 km/h and is part of the Amsterdam city route s116. It provides a fast road connection between the ring road A10 and the IJtunnel. name: Nieuwe Leuvebrug
en: The Nieuwe Leuvebrug is a bascule bridge in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. This bridge over the passage of the Leuvehaven to the Nieuwe Maas connects the mainland and the Boompjes. name: Nieuwe Meer
en: The Nieuwe Meer (or 'the' Nieuwe Meer) is a narrow lake southwest of Amsterdam. It forms the connection between the Schinkel in Amsterdam and the Ringvaart of the Haarlemmermeerpolder. name: Nieuwe Meersluis
en: The Nieuwe Meersluis, also known as Schinkelsluis, is a sluice gate in the Dutch municipality of Amsterdam.

name: Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat
en: The Nieuwe Passeerdersstraat is a street in the Jordaan in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Nieuwe Tolbrug
en: The Nieuwe Tolbrug in the Dutch town of Voorburg (also known as Kippetjesbrug or Kippenbruggetje) is a lift bridge over the Vliet dating back to 1891/1892. During construction, the bridge was built as a fixed bridge. In 1919, the bridge was converted into a lift bridge. The bridge is a national monument.

name: Nieuwe-Wercksbrug
en: The Nieuwe-Wercksbrug (bridge no. 63) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It connects the Westermarkt with the Rozengracht, spanning the Prinsengracht at the Oude Wester.

name: Nieuwegracht
en: The Nieuwegracht is one of the most famous canals in the city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is also the name for the two streets on either side of this canal. Characteristic are the many monumental canal houses, the warehouse cellars, yards with trees, and bridges.

name: Nieuwendammerkerk
en: The Nieuwendammerkerk is the village church of the dyke village of Nieuwendam in Amsterdam-Noord. It does not stand along the Nieuwendammerdijk but slightly lower behind it on the Brede Kerkepad. It is a handsomely sited village church with a graveyard around it.

name: Nieuwendammersluis
en: The Nieuwendammersluis is a historic lock in the Nieuwendammerdijk in Amsterdam-North. It was originally a sea lock in the Nieuwendammerdijk, which was part of the Waterlandse Zeedijk and the Noorder IJ and Zeedijk.

name: Nijlhaven
en: The Nijlhaven is a port on the Maasvlakte in Rotterdam. An LNG terminal, GATE (Gas Access To Europe), is located at the port and is 13.5 meters deep. name: Nollewoudsbrug
en: Brug 432 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge, long carrying bus line 32 and since 2018 line 35, lies in the Purmerweg and Nieuwe Purmerweg and spans the ring ditch of the Buikslotermeer. There have been three versions: it began in 1937 as a wooden bridge in open countryside, with no buildings yet around it.

name: Nollewoudsbrug
en: Bridge 432 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-North. The traffic bridge, over which bus line 32 used to run, since 2018 bus line 35, is located in the Purmerweg / Nieuwe Purmerweg and spans the ring ditch of the Buikslotermeer. There are three versions of this bridge. It began in 1937 as a wooden bridge in a rural area; there is no buildings yet to be found.

name: Noord Singelsgracht
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Noord West Singelsgracht
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Noorder Amstelkanaal
en: The Noorder Amstelkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-Zuid. The canal was dug as part of the Plan Zuid by architect H.P. Berlage. It was built to facilitate the development of Nieuw Zuid.

name: Noorder IJplas
en: The Noorder IJplas is a sand mining pond in the former Noorder IJpolder in northwest Amsterdam. The polder is one of the IJpolders drained in 1872 along the North Sea Canal.

name: Noorderbrug
en: The Noorderbrug in the Dutch city of Rotterdam is a bridge over the Rotte near the Noordplein. The bridge forms the connection between the Oude Noorden and Crooswijk. It is 40 meters long and 20 meters wide.

name: Noorderkanaal
en: The Bergsluis is a lock in the Noorderkanaal in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland. The lock is located between the Rotterdam Schie and the lower Rotte. The waterway is CEMT class 0. The lock dates back to 1938. The lock is 86.00 m long and 6.00 m wide. The threshold depth on the west side is KP −2.35 m, on the east side KP −2.30 m.

name: Noorderpark
en: The Noorderpark is a park in Amsterdam-North. It was created in 2014 after the merger of the Florapark and Volewijkspark located on either side of the North Holland Canal.

name: Noordersluis
en: Noordersluis is an industrial area in the Lelystad-Haven district in Lelystad. The district has an area of 2 km². In addition to companies, there is a vocational school located in the east of the industrial area and there are some residential neighborhoods in the industrial area. In Noordersluis there live 402 people, of whom 226 men and 176 women.

name: Noordzeeweg
en: The Noordzeeweg is a connecting road in Amsterdam Westpoort and connects the Basisweg at the T-intersection with the Hornweg with the Westpoortweg and Luvernes. The road was named after the North Sea by a council decision of April 26, 1978.

name: Noordzijde
en: The Noordzijde is a street in Amsterdam Slotermeer. This is also the north bank of the Sloterplas. Since 2017, the Noordzijde, along with the northern bank of the Sloterplas, has been designated as a Municipal Protected Urban Landscape.

name: Nootdorpboog
en: The Nootdorpboog is a single-track connection for NS train equipment between the Gouda - The Hague railway line and the NS Maintenance & Service workshop along the Hofplein line in Leidschendam. name: Norwegian church
en: The Norwegian Sailor's Church (Sjømannskirken i Rotterdam) is a church in Rotterdam. The building is located on the Westzeedijk, next to the entrance to Het Park.

name: NSM-brug
en: The NSM-brug (bridge 356) is a bascule bridge in the Klaprozenweg, spanning Zijkanaal I in Amsterdam-Noord. The bridge opened on 22 April 2018 is the third version. It mattered for opening up Tuindorp Oostzaan and was originally a single steel drawbridge connected to its abutments by many approach spans.

name: NSM-brug

The bridge was important for the opening up of Tuindorp Oostzaan and was originally a single steel lifting bridge where the bridge, with many bridges, had landheads

name: O.L.V. Altijddurende Bijstand
en: The Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Altijddurende Assistance Church is a former Catholic church in the district Overschie in Rotterdam. The church is named after Onze-Lieve-Vrouw van Altijddurende Bijstand, a title of Mary.

name: O.L.V. Onbevlekt Ontvangen / Elandstraatkerk
en: The Our Lady Onbevlekt Received Church, also known as the Eland Church or Elandstraatkerk, is a Roman Catholic church on Elandstraat in the Zeeheldenkwartier district of The Hague. The church building and the parish community are part of the parish of Maria Sterre der Zee. In November 2023, the parish board announced its intention to open the Our Lady of the

name: Odebrug
en: The Odebrug, or ODE-brug, short for Oosterdokseiland, is a fixed bridge in the centre of Amsterdam connecting Oosterdokseiland with the Prins Hendrikkade. It is made of prefabricated concrete elements, steel and aluminium and consists of three parts. The pedestrian deck is finished with finely ground basalt grit.

name: Odebrug
en: The Odebrug or ODE bridge (abbreviation for Oosterdokseiland) is a fixed bridge in the center of the Dutch capital Amsterdam that connects Oosterdokseiland with Prins Hendrikkade. The bridge consists of prefabricated concrete elements, steel and aluminum and consists of three parts.

name: Oesjesduiker
en: The Oesjesduiker is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Oetewalerbrug
en: The Oetewalerbrug (bridge no. 189) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Ringvaart of the Watergraafsmeer, connecting the Linnaeusstraat, called Oetewalerweg until 1878, with the Middenweg in the former Overamstelse Polder and the reclaimed Watergraafsmeer. Until 1896 it lay on a municipal boundary.

name: Oetewalerbrug
en: The Oetewalerbrug (bridge no. 189) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Ringvaart of the Amsterdam Watergraafsmeer. It provides the connection between Linnaeusstraat, until 1878 Oetewalerweg, and Middenweg in the former Overamstelse Polder with the Watergraafsmeer drainage works.

name: Old Harbour Rotterdam
en: The Old Harbor, also Oudehaven and Oude haven, is one of the oldest harbors in Rotterdam, in the Dutch province of South Holland. It is located in the center of the city, southeast of Rotterdam Blaak station.

name: Oldegaarde
en: The Oldegaarde is a road in Charlois on Rotterdam-Zuid. The road connects the Groene Kruisweg via the Zuiderparkweg with the Vaanweg. It forms the northern border of the Pendrecht and Zuidwijk neighborhoods and the southern border of the Zuiderpark.

name: Olympiahuis
en: The Olympic House (the house on Stadionplein nr. 18), also known as the Gatekeeper's House, or Northern Service House, is a former gatekeeper's house on the grounds in Amsterdam, where the 1928 Olympic Games took place. During these games, it served as a post office. Like the Olympic Stadium, it was designed by architect Jan Wils. The O

name: Olympiahuis
en: The Olympiahuisje, the small building at Stadionplein 18, also called the Portiershuisje or Noordelijke Dienstwoning, is a former porter's house on the Amsterdam grounds where the 1928 Olympic Games were held. During those games it served as a post office. Like the Olympic Stadium it was designed by the architect Jan Wils.

name: Omar-al-Faroukmoskee
en: The Omar-Al-Faroukmoskee is a mosque on Winterboeidreef in Utrecht. The building was originally built as the Roman Catholic Emmaus Church.

name: Omniversum
en: Omniversum is a large-screen cinema in the west of the Zorgvliet district in The Hague. The screen is like a half-sphere around the audience and provides a better experience than a flat screen. An advanced sound system produces audible signals but also extra low tones that are particularly noticeable. There are 300 seats. The name Omniversum is sam

name: Omvalbrug
en: The Omvalbrug, bridge no. 429, is a lift bridge between the Amsterdam districts of Watergraafsmeer and Overamstel. It lies close to the Amstelstation, in the Spaklerweg, and crosses the Weespertrekvaart beside the elevated rail and metro line. It dates from 1953 but only came into use for traffic once the Spaklerweg opened.

name: Omvalbrug
en: The Omvalbrug, bridge no. 429, is a movable bridge between the Amsterdam neighborhoods of Watergraafsmeer and Overamstel. The bridge is located near Amstel station and is located in Spaklerweg and crosses the Weespertrekvaart next to the elevated railway and metro track.

name: Onbevlekt Hart van Maria
en: The Onbevlekt Hart of Mariakerk, also known as the Marlotkerk, is a Roman Catholic church building on Bloklandenplein in The Hague.

name: Onze Lieve Vrouw Hemelvaartkerk
en: The Onze Lieve Vrouw Hemelvaartkerk is a Roman Catholic church in Loosduinen in the Dutch city of The Hague. The church belongs to the community of "Maria van Eik en Duinen", part of the parish of the Parish of the Four Evangelists. The church is located on the Loosduinse Hoofdstraat.

name: Onze Lieve Vrouwe Kapel
en: The Onze Lieve Vrouwe Kapel is a chapel in Amsterdam-Oost. It is located on the south side of the Ruyschstraat/ 's-Gravesandeplein in Amsterdam.

name: Ookmeerweg
en: The Ookmeerweg is a continuous road in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West. The name of the street was established by a municipal council decision on April 17, 1957. The road is named after the Ookmeer, a reclamation area east of the old neighborhood of Osdorp, on (approximately) the site of the current Sportpark Ookmeer.

name: Oorlogsmonument 'Grenadiers en Jagers'
en: The Monument Grenadiers and Jagers is a monument in memory of military personnel from the Regiment Garde Grenadiers and Jagers who have died since 1940. The statue was created by artist Dirk Bus and was unveiled in 1951.

name: Oorlogsmonument 'Leger en Vloot'
en: The Monument Leger and Vloot commemorates the Dutch troops that were mobilized during World War I and the victims who fell during that war. The monument is located on the Boulevard in Scheveningen, near the Kurhaus, at the corner of the staircase that goes from the Boulevard to the beach. It was unveiled on September 20, 1921 by koni

name: Oost Singelsgracht
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Oost-Abtsbrug
en: The Oost-Abtsbrug is a steel collection bridge over the Schiedamse Schie in Schiedam. The Oost-Abtsbrug connects the Rotterdam business parks North West and Spaanse Polder. The Matlingeweg is the main access road for both business parks. This road runs from the A20 over the Oost-Abtsbrug and the Doenbrug to the A13. The Oost-Abtsbrug has a through

name: Oost-Indische Huisbrug
en: The Oost-Indische Huisbrug (bridge 223) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Kloveniersburgwal and thus forms the connection between Russia and the southern quay of the Raamgracht. The bridge has been a municipal monument since October 10, 1995.

name: Oost-Indische Huisbrug
en: The Oost-Indische Huisbrug (bridge 223) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Kloveniersburgwal, connecting the Rusland with the southern quay of the Raamgracht. It has been a municipal monument since 10 October 1995 and is named after the Oost-Indisch Huis on the corner of the Kloveniersburgwal and the Oude Hoogstraat.

name: Oostelijk Marktkanaal
en: The Oostelijk Marktkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-West. The canal branches off from the Kostverlorenvaart in a northerly direction at the Beltbrug and opened up the grounds of the Centrale Markthallen on the east side. Along the Buyskade lies the Buysbrug over the Oostelijk Marktkanaal, over which a bicycle path leads to Jan van Galenstraat. The canal

name: Oosterbeerbrug
en: The Oosterbeerbrug (bridge 354) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Oosterparkkerk
en: The Oosterparkkerk stands on the west side of the Oosterpark in Amsterdam, in the Oosterparkbuurt.

name: Oosterstroom
en: The Oosterstroom is an ancient canal in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The watercourse lies directly north of the city center on the border of the neighborhoods Lauwerecht and Vogelenbuurt. On the south side, this approximately 400-meter-long canal runs towards the Stadsbuitengracht (Weerdsingel).

name: Oostertocht
en: Oostertocht is a district, located in the town of Heerhugowaard in the Netherlands. The district borders 't Kruis, Huygenhoek, the Molenwijk and the Rivierenwijk. Construction began in the district around 1994 and around 2001 the district was completed as a whole. In 2012-2013 drainage was replaced in part of the district due to a high groundwater level.

name: Oostertoegang
en: The Oostertoegang is a short canal in Amsterdam-Centrum, directly east of Central Station, that connects the IJ to the Geldersekade and the Open Havenfront between Stationsplein and Prins Hendrikkade.

name: Oostmolenwerf
en: The Oostmolenwerf is a street in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, which runs from the Maasboulevard to the Burgemeester Van Walsumweg, Oostzeedijk and the Oostplein, where it merges into it. Side streets of the Oostmolenwerf are the Admiraliteitskade, the Haringvliet and the Nieuwehaven.

name: Oostoever
en: Oostoever is a street in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, located mostly in the Oostoever Sloterplas neighborhood.

name: Oostplein
en: The Oostplein is a traffic square in Rotterdam. The Oostplein is the eastern point of the city triangle and is located on the site of the former Oostpoort.

name: Open Havenfront
en: The Open Havenfront is the water between the Prins Hendrikkade and the Stationseiland in Amsterdam. Over this water lie three wide bridges, equipped with separate lanes for cars or footpaths and tram rails: the Western Access Bridge (bridge no. 13), the Sint Nicolaas Bridge (Middle Access Bridge; bridge no. 306) and the Kamper Bridge (bridge no. 285).

name: Opstandingskerk
en: The Opstandingskerk is a monumental church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is located in the Zuilen district. It was built in 1957 for the Apostolic Society according to a design by Anthonie de Ridder. The building is valued as a municipal monument. Currently, a Dutch Reformed church is located there.

name: Opstandingskerk
en: The Opstandingskerk is a church in Amsterdam West, at Bos en Lommerplein 325 on the western part of the square. While it was still being built it acquired the nickname Kolenkit, coal scuttle, because its 48-metre bell tower resembles one. The name stuck so well that the surrounding neighbourhood was named after it: the Kolenkitbuurt.

name: Oranjeboomstraat
