en: The Spanish Bridge is a steel drawbridge over the Delfshavense Schie, in the district of Overschie of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam. The first Spanish Bridge was opened in 1952 and formed the connection between the Second High Railway in Overschie and the industrial area Spaanse Polder.

name: Spaarndammerdijk
en: The Spaarndammerdijk is a dike that was built from the first half of the 13th century to protect the peatland grazing area south of the still not drained IJ. The dike ran from the Amstel to the Spaarne along the southern bank of the arm of the sea and was also the northern boundary of the High Council of Rhineland. At the height of the Sp

name: Spaarndammerstraat
en: The Spaarndammerstraat is a residential and shopping street in the Spaarndammerbuurt in Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Spaarndammertunnel
en: The Spaarndammertunnel is a tunnel for car traffic in Amsterdam-West.

name: Spaklerweg
en: The Spaklerweg is a street in the Amsterdam neighborhoods of Watergraafsmeer and Overamstel and in Amsterdam-Duivendrecht, which belongs to the municipality of Ouder-Amstel. The street was opened to traffic around 1960 to open up the then newly built industrial district of Overamstel.

name: Spanjaardsbrug
en: The Spanjaardsbrug is a double bascule bridge over the harbor "het Haringvliet" in the city triangle (the center) of the Dutch city Rotterdam, next to the Oude Haven. The bridge connects the north side of the Haringvliet with the Oudehoofdplein. It is the only remaining hydraulic bascule bridge of the seven realized. The waterway is CEMT class I. Due to

name: Spanjemonument
en: The Spanjemonument is an artistic work and war memorial in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Speelmanstraat
en: Speelmanstraat is a street in the Amsterdam garden city of Slotermeer. The street was named after resistance fighter Wim Speelman on July 9, 1952.

name: Spijkenisserbrug
en: The Spijkenisserbrug is a traffic bridge over the Oude Maas between the Dutch towns of Hoogvliet and Spijkenisse. The S102 (the Green Cross Road) runs on this bridge. Until 2016, the bridge was part of the N492.

name: Spinoza
en: The statue of Spinoza is a 19th-century monument in The Hague, in memory of the philosopher Benedictus de Spinoza.

name: Spinozabrug
en: The Spinozabrug is a bascule bridge with two parallel bridge decks in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It lies between the Lessinglaan and the Spinozaweg over the Merwedekanaal. Adjacent streets are also the Keulsekade and the Kanaalweg. The bridge was already under construction before 1940 but in 1942 the German occupiers announced a halt to construction.

name: Spinozahuis
en: Domus Spinozana or Spinozahuis is a house on Paviljoensgracht 72 in The Hague, Netherlands, where the philosopher Spinoza lived until his death. The house was built in 1646 at the behest of the painter Jan van Goyen who sold it to Havick Steen, the father of Jan Steen. In 1661 Spinoza leaves Amsterdam for Rijnsburg, where he lives in the house

name: Spoorbrug Nootdorpboog
en: The Spoorbrug Nootdorpboog is a railway bridge in the Dutch province of South Holland, on the border between Nootdorp and Leidschenveen-Ypenburg. The bridge over the A12 motorway is part of the Nootdorpboog railway line.

name: Spoordijk
en: A railway, track or railway line is a road of railway rails or tracks. Locomotives, such as trains and subways, are suitable for running over a railway. A railway consists of one or more tracks. A track consists of two parallel steel railway rails. Rails are often mounted on crossbars. The crossbars are in a ball

name: Spoorsingel
en: The Spoorsingel is a street in Rotterdam on the north side of Rotterdam Central Station. The Spoorsingel runs from Walenburgerweg to Proveniersplein.

name: Spoorwegbassin
en: The Spoorwegbassin is a port in the Eastern Port Area of Amsterdam. The port is located east of the Cornelis van Eesterenlaan and flows into the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal.

name: Spoorweghavenbrug
en: The Spoorweghavenbrug is a lift bridge in the Feijenoord district of the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam, part of the Stieltjesstraat. The bridge spans the Spoorweghaven and is named after it. This is the third bridge in this place. The first bridge, a swing bridge, was built in 1880 and was popularly known as the Koffiemolenbrug.

name: Sportlaan
en: The Sportlaan is one of the north-east to south-west running, about two kilometer long avenue in the southwest of The Hague that runs from Houtrustweg to De Savornin Lohmanlaan. In the extension is the Machiel Vrijenhoeklaan to Kijkduin. The Sportlaan separates the Vogelwijk from the Bomenbuurt and Bohemen-Meer and Bos. Southeast of the street runs d

name: Spuihaven
en: The Spuihaven is a harbor in Schiedam. The harbor is 400 meters long, 20 meters wide and the depth is NAP -4 meters. The entrance is located at kilometer post 1007.3 on the right bank of the Nieuwe Maas. There is a green fixed light on the west side of the entrance. At the end of the harbor there is a sluice gate in the Havendijk.

name: St. Dominicuskerk
en: The Sint-Dominicuskerk is a Roman Catholic parish church in the Dutch city of Utrecht, located in the Oog in Al district. The church was built in 1951 and designed by Herman van Putten in the style of the Bossche School. On November 22, 1951, the church was inaugurated by Bishop Alfrink.

name: St. Jacobuskerk
en: The Sint-Jacobuskerk is a church building in the Utrecht district of Zuilen. Today it no longer bears this name, but is known as the Best Life Church, after the evangelical congregation with the same name. The church building was originally dedicated to James the Greater. In 2017 the building was removed from the Eucharistic celebration.

name: Staalmanpark
en: The Staalmanpark is a city park in Amsterdam-Nieuw-West.

name: Staalmeestersbrug
en: The Staalmeestersbrug (bridge 227) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Groenburgwal and lies in the Staalstraat, which runs along both sides of that canal. With bridge 226 it is one of only two bridges over the canal. A municipal monument since 1995, it is surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Staalmeestersbrug
en: The Staalmeestersbrug (bridge 227) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the Groenburgwal and is located in Staalstraat, which lies on both sides of the Groenburgwal. It is next to bridge 226, the only bridge over the canal.

name: Staatsliedenbrug
en: The Staatsliedenbrug (bridge 139) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. The bridge forms the connection between the Van Limburg Stirumstraat and the Tweede Nassaustraat. It spans the Kostverlorenvaart with its quays De Wittenkade. Most of the Kostverlorenvaart is part of the Staandemast route through Amsterdam-West, but not just this section

name: Staatsliedenbrug
en: The Staatsliedenbrug (bridge 139) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Oud-West. It connects the Van Limburg Stirumstraat with the Tweede Nassaustraat, spanning the Kostverlorenvaart and its quays at De Wittenkade. Most of the Kostverlorenvaart forms part of the Staandemastroute through Amsterdam-West, but not this stretch.

name: Stadhouderskade
en: The Stadhouderskade is a street in Amsterdam-West and Amsterdam-Zuid, on the west and south bank of the Singelgracht from the Overtoom to the Amstel.

name: Stadhouderspoort
en: The Stadhouderspoort is a gate that connects the Binnenhof and Buitenhof in The Hague. It is one of the four (most western) still existing gates of the Binnenhof complex.

name: Stadhuisbrug
en: The Stadhuisbrug is a bridge over the Oudegracht in the city center of Utrecht. In addition to the town hall and the main branch of the municipal library, several shops are located on the Stadhuisbrug. A windmill is visible in the paving of the bridge. The Stadhuisbrug was created in 1547 by the connection of two older bridges, the (southern) Huidenbrug e

name: Stadiongracht
en: The Stadiongracht is a canal in Amsterdam-Zuid; dug around 1928.

name: Stadionlaan
en: The Stadionlaan is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The street runs from Rubenslaan and Adriaen van Ostadelaan to Herculeslaan. A side street of the Stadionlaan is the Laan van Minsweerd. In 1938, the viaduct was built on Rijksweg 22 over the Stadionlaan. The Stadionflat is located on the Stadionlaan. The street and the flat are named after

name: Stadionplein
en: The Stadionplein is a square in Amsterdam-Zuid, which was built in the 1920s at the intersection of Stadionweg and Amstelveenseweg to better control car traffic to the site of the 1928 Summer Olympic Games in Amsterdam. It is located on the border of H.P. Berlage's Plan Zuid and the more modernist

name: Stadionweg
en: The Stadionweg is a street in the Zuid district of Amsterdam. The street is the access road to the Olympic Stadium, but is named after the stadium designed by architect Harry Elte that stood at the corner of the current Stadionweg and Stadionplein between 1914 and 1929.

name: Stadsbuitengracht
en: The Stadsbuitengracht is the canal around the old city center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. The Stadsbuitengracht was built in the twelfth century as a defensive work of the city. The waterways Kromme Rijn and Vaartsche Rijn flow into the southern part of the Stadsbuitengracht, the Utrechtse Vecht begins in the northern part. Along the few kilometers

name: Stadsgraanzuiger 19
en: Stadsgraanzuiger No.19 is an Antwerp grain elevator owned by the Maritime Museum in Rotterdam. It is the only remaining floating grain elevator in Europe and is operated both in Antwerp and Rotterdam as a museum ship and floating monument. The ship consists of a pontoon with a steel construction, in which two steam engines are located at the top.

name: Stadspark Osdorp
en: The Stadspark Osdorp is a park in the Amsterdam district of Osdorp. It is a fairly new park, it was expanded in 1990 and took its current form in the years following as part of the large-scale urban renewal of Osdorp. The park is located along the west side of Hoekenes between Tussen Meer and the Pieter Calandlaan and east of the Wolbra

name: Stadsschouwburg Utrecht
en: The Stadsschouwburg is the largest theater building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It was designed in 1937 by the famous architect Willem Dudok. The building is located on the Lucasfort, on the edge of the Utrecht city center. The city theater was opened on September 3, 1941 and housed the Esplanade restaurant (with balcony terrace) at the time.

name: Stadswerf Koningspoort
en: The Koningspoort ship slip is a museum ship slip built in 1983 on the site where the passageway from the Maas to the Old Port of Rotterdam used to be. name: Statentunnel
en: The Statentunnel is a traffic tunnel with a length of over 100 meters in the center of Rotterdam and is part of the Tunneltraverse. The tunnel lies between the intersection with the Beukelsdijk and the Weena and the Bentinckplein in the Blijdorp district and crosses the platform of Rotterdam Central station.

name: Steen van de miljoenen tranen
en: The Steen van de miljoenen tranen is a memorial monument on Willem Ruyslaan in Rotterdam. It was established in memory of the horrors of the 1940s-1945, commissioned by the Foundation for Civil War Victims. The artist Truus Menger-Oversteegen, a former resistance fighter, made it. The artwork was unveiled on May 12, 199

name: Steenhouwerijbrug
en: The Steenhouwerijbrug or Steenhouwerijsluis (bridge 45) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The arched bridge is located on the northeast bank of the Keizersgracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. The bridge gets its name from the Stadsmetseltuin that was located on the Leidsegracht during the planning of this neighborhood.

name: Steenhouwerijbrug
en: The Steenhouwerijbrug or Steenhouwerijsluis (bridge 45) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The arched bridge lies in the north-east bank of the Keizersgracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. It takes its name from the Stadsmetseltuin, the city masonry yard that stood on the Leidsegracht when this neighbourhood was laid out.

name: Stieltjesmonument
en: The Stieltjesmonument is a monument on the North Island in the Dutch municipality of Rotterdam in memory of Th.J. Stieltjes.

name: Strandweg
en: The municipality of Westland has eight official beach access points, listed below from north to south. Along the dunes is a cycling path that is part of the National Cycling Route 1 and the Dune and Greenhouse Route.

name: Strevelsweg
en: The Strevelsweg is a street in Rotterdam. It belongs partly to the Bloemhof district, and the Vreewijk district, although it still uses the postal code of Bloemhof. name: Sultan Ahmet
en: The Noorderkerk is a monumental building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The building on Royaards van den Hamkade 20 was built around 1922 for the Reformed Church in the new Ondiep district. The architect D.J. Heusinkveld designed the church building in a predominantly sober style of the Amsterdam School with a connection to the surrounding area.

name: Suurhoffbrug
en: The Suurhoffbrug connects the two banks of the Hartel Canal in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The bridge consists of, side by side, a railway bridge and a bridge for car traffic; these two bridges have the same name. The bridge is part of the A15 and has 2×2 lanes here. The railway bridge of the Rotterdam Harbour Line is located on the west side

name: Syphonsluis
en: The Merwedekanaal siphon is a feeder tunnel, or water transport tunnel, that connects two branches of the Merwedekanaal on the south side of the city of Utrecht under the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal (ARK). The current siphon has existed since 1973 and has replaced an older, steel passage. This had to be replaced because the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal

name: Tante Saarbrug
en: The Tante Saarbrug (bridge 31) is a fixed arch bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Tasmanstraat
en: The Tasmanstraat is a residential street in the Amsterdam Spaarndammer neighborhood.

name: Tennesseehaven
en: The Tennesseehaven is a port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Beerkanaal. The pet factory of Indorama (formerly Voridian-Eastman Chemical Company) is located at this port. The port was dredged in 1996 and first used in 1997. The name is derived from the American state of Tennessee where Eastman's headquarters is located.

name: Terbregseweg
en: Terbregseweg is a "never opened station" on the Utrecht - Rotterdam railway line. It was located in the east of Rotterdam, on the so-called Ceintuurbaan.

name: Tetje de Jongbrug
en: Tetje de Jongbrug (bridge 100) is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge is located on the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Looiersgracht. This canal has only three bridges, the Looierssluis (bridge 103), bridge 102 and this bridge 100. Bridge 101, the Nieuwe Amstelbrug, spans the Amstel, so elsewhere in the city.

name: Tetje de Jongbrug
en: Tetje de Jongbrug (bridge 100) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the eastern quay of the Lijnbaansgracht and spans the Looiersgracht. That canal has only three bridges: the Looierssluis (bridge 103), bridge 102 and this one. Bridge 101, the Nieuwe Amstelbrug, crosses the Amstel elsewhere in the city.

name: The Movies
en: The Movies is a cinema in Amsterdam. The Movies is the oldest still in use cinema in Amsterdam. The complex is located at Haarlemmerdijk 161-163 on the outskirts of the Jordaan. The Movies was founded in 1912 under the name Bioscoop Tavenu. Two years later, the name was changed to Cinema Hollandia. Until World War II, it served as d

name: Theater aan het Spui
en: Theater aan het Spui is a medium-sized flat-floor theater located on the Spui, the cultural heart of The Hague. It is located next to the Nieuwe Kerk and the Filmhuis Den Haag. The theater is a design by architect Herman Hertzberger and has two rooms: the large room with 360 seats and the small room with 170 seats. There is a spacious lobby. Theat

name: Theater Amsterdam
en: Theater Amsterdam is a theatre in Amsterdam. For the moment it is the only theatre in the city intended for productions that run for as long as the public is interested. It opened on 8 May 2014 with the production Anne, based on the diary of Anne Frank.

name: Theater Amsterdam
en: Theater Amsterdam is a theater in Amsterdam. It is for the time being the only theater in Amsterdam that is intended for performances that run as long as the public is interested. On May 8, 2014, the theater opened with the performance Anne, based on the diary of Anne Frank. Theater Amsterdam is the first theater specially built for theater system

name: Theater De Regentes
en: Theater De Regentes (officially "De Nieuwe Regentes" after a restart) in The Hague was originally called Theater Zwembad de Regentes and was founded in 1996.

name: Theater Kikker
en: Theater Kikker is a theater on the Ganzenmarkt in the city center of Utrecht. The theater has two rooms in which a mixture of contemporary theater and modern dance is performed. Kikker works a lot with volunteers.

name: Theater PePijn
en: PePijn is a theater in The Hague that has focused on cabaret, stand-up comedy and small arts.

name: Theater Zuidplein
en: The Theater Zuidplein is a theater on the Zuidplein in Rotterdam, near the Zuidplein Shopping Center.

name: Theo Fransmanbrug
en: The Theo Fransmanbrug (bridge number 1788) is a structure in Amsterdam-Noord. For almost a century the Papaverweg in the Buiksloterham neighbourhood was a dead end running from the built-up area to Zijkanaal I. There was also a small inlet called the Papaverkanaal, for years the site of a city refuse depot.

name: Theo Fransmanbrug
en: The Theo Fransmanbrug (bridge number 1788) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-North. The Papaverweg in the Buiksloterham area was a dead-end road from buildings to Zijkanaal I for almost a century. There was also a docking harbor called Papaverkanaal where for years there was a drainage depot from the City Cleaning Department.

name: Theo Thijssen Museum
en: The Theo Thijssen Museum is a museum in Amsterdam devoted to the writer, teacher and politician Theo Thijssen. It is run by the Stichting Theo Thijssen and occupies the ground floor of Thijssen's birthplace at Eerste Leliedwarsstraat 16.

name: Theo van Goghpark
en: The Theo van Goghpark is a city park in the Amsterdam district of IJburg. The park is located on Haveneiland-Oost, south of the Pampuslaan, near the terminus of tram line 26 (IJtram). The park is partially built in a recessed manner but on the side of Pampuslaan it is actually built in an elevated manner and accessible by a wide staircase.

name: Theresia van Gelderen
en: The list of Stolpersteine in Utrecht (municipality) gives an overview of the commemorative stones that have been placed in the municipality of Utrecht in the Dutch province of Utrecht as part of the Stolpersteine project of the German sculptor-artist Gunter Demnig. Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were murdered by it.

name: Theresiastraat
en: The Theresiastraat is a shopping street located in the Hague district of Bezuidenhout. The street is named after Queen Regent Emma, the second wife of King William III. Her first names were Adelheid Emma Wilhelmina Theresia. Her three other first names can be found in the naming of some side streets of the Theresiastraat.

name: This is Holland
en: THIS IS HOLLAND is a tourist attraction with a panoramic flight simulator in Amsterdam. It opened in 2017 in Amsterdam-Noord, next to the Eye Filmmuseum, in a 24-metre-high cylindrical pavilion on the former Shell site Overhoeks, above the underground car park of the A'DAM Toren.

name: Thomaskerk
en: The Thomaskerk, or De Thomas, on the Prinses Irenestraat in Amsterdam-Zuid was built in 1966 and belongs to the Protestant Church of Amsterdam.

name: Thorbecke statue
en: The statue of Johan Rudolph Thorbecke, or Thorbecke monument, is a 19th-century memorial in Amsterdam to the liberal politician Thorbecke.

name: Tijnmuidenbrug
en: The Tijnmuidenbrug, designated KW517, is a structural work of art in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The structure is located on the Westrandweg, part of the A5 motorway. It spans the Amsterdam traffic road Dortmuiden. The architectural firm Zwarts & Jansma Architecten was responsible for the design of this national road and all its works of art. The road was m

name: Tijnmuidenbrug
en: The Tijnmuidenbrug, designated KW517, is a structure in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Westrandweg, part of the A5 motorway, and spans the Amsterdam road Dortmuiden. Zwarts & Jansma Architecten were responsible for the design of this motorway and all its structures.

name: Timo Smeehuijzenbrug
en: Timo Smeehuijzenbrug (bridge 407) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Tobacco Theater
en: The Tobacco Theater is a national monument on the theatre street Nes in Amsterdam, at odd numbers 75 to 87. Like other buildings on the Nes, such as the Comedy Theater, Theater De Engelenbak and Frascati, it was originally a tobacco factory. Its angled window bays let a great deal of light into the building.

name: Tobacco Theater
en: The Tobacco Theater is a national monument, located on the "theaterstraat" Nes in Amsterdam (odd house numbers 75 to 87). The building was originally, as well as other buildings in the Nes such as the Comedy Theater, Theater De Engelenbak and Frascati, a tobacco factory.

name: Tolsteegbarrière
en: The Tolsteegbarrière is a culvert at the southern end of the Oudegracht. Together with the Tolsteeg Bridge over the Stadsbuitengracht (singel), it forms a small square in the far south of the Old Town of Utrecht. The square is located at the end of the Oudegracht. The square is often colloquially referred to as Ledig Erf, but this is the official name.

name: Tolsteegbrug
en: The Tolsteegbrug is a bridge and street name in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The arched bridge was built around 1925 in the south of the Utrecht city center over the Stadsbuitengracht. An older bridge was replaced, which was narrower and had multiple bridge piers. The design of the new bridge with retaining walls is in the style of the Amsterdam School and was

name: Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt
en: The Torenfort aan de Ossenmarkt is a tower fort in Weesp in the province of North Holland.

name: Torensluis
en: The Torensluis (bridge no. 9) is a characteristic arched bridge over the Singel in Amsterdam's inner city and, at 42 metres, one of the widest in the city. It is so wide because a tower once stood on it, the Jan Roodenpoortstoren. While it was being designed in 1648 there was a plan to build shops on the very broad bridge.

name: Torensluis
en: The Torensluis (bridge no. 9) is a characteristic arched bridge over the Singel in the Old Town of Amsterdam and with 42 meters one of the widest in the city. The reason for this is that a tower stood on the bridge, the Jan Roodenpoortstoren. During the design of the bridge in 1648, the plan arose to build shops on the very wide bridge, just like

name: Torontobrug
en: The Torontobrug (bridge 350) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge on the boundary between De Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid and Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Amstel. On the west side it lies in line with the Stadhouderskade and at right angles to the Amsteldijk, formerly Utrechtsezijde; on the east side it continues as the Mauritskade.

name: Torontobrug
en: The Torontobrug (bridge 350) in Amsterdam is a double bascule bridge on the border between Amsterdam-Zuid, De Pijp and Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Amstel. On the west side it lies along the Stadhouderskade and is perpendicular to the Amsteldijk (formerly Utrechtsezijde). On the east side it lies along the Mauritskade. From the bridge has

name: Torontohaven
en: The Torontohaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam. On the north side is Vopak Terminal TTR, on the east side is Service Terminal Rotterdam.

name: Tranen
en: Tranen for the Resistance or Two Tears is an artistic work by Bernard Heesen in one of the passages of the Max Euweplein in the center of Amsterdam. The artwork commemorates the former Detention Center on the Weteringschans. This building was used during the occupation in World War II by the Sicherheitsdienst and Gestapo. A ve

name: Tranen
en: Tranen voor het verzet, or Twee tranen, is an artistic work by Bernard Heesen in one of the passages of the Max Euweplein in the centre of Amsterdam. It commemorates the former house of detention on the Weteringschans, a building used during the occupation in the Second World War by the Sicherheitsdienst and the Gestapo.

name: Transformatorweg
en: The Transformatorweg is an important thoroughfare in Amsterdam, in the Westpoort district.

name: Trapjesbrug
en: Bridge 130 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The pedestrian bridge, colloquially known as the Trapjesbrug, forms the connection between Tuinstraat and Nieuwe Tuinstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht and lands on the Westerkade (western quay of the Lijnbaansgracht).

name: Trapjesbrug
en: Brug 130 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The footbridge, popularly called the Trapjesbrug, connects the Tuinstraat with the Nieuwe Tuinstraat. It spans the Lijnbaansgracht and lands on the Westerkade, that canal's western quay. A bridge of steel and wood was placed here in 1921 and renovated and raised in 1965.

name: Treurende vrouw
en: Treurende vrouw is a war monument in Rotterdam. It commemorates the twenty Dutch resistance fighters (including Teunis Abbenbroek) who were executed on March 12, 1945 on the spot in Goereesestraat near the Pleinweg in Rotterdam-Zuid by the German occupiers. The work of art by Cor van Kralingen replaced a monument nearby, which had to make way for new

name: Trêveszaal
en: The Trêveszaal is a historic meeting room from 1697 in the Binnenhof in The Hague and is part of the buildings of the Ministry of General Affairs. Since 1977 it has been the permanent meeting room of the Dutch Council of Ministers. The Trêveszaal and the adjacent States Hall are also used for official receptions of the Prime Minister and the mini

name: Triumfatorkerk
en: The Triumfatorkerk is a monumental church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is located in the Kanaleneiland subdistrict. It was built in 1965 to the design of Jos and Leo de Jonge. The building is valued as a municipal monument. The church was originally used by Reformed and Reformed people.

name: Tuindorpkerk
en: The Tuindorpkerk is a Protestant church on the corner of Professor Suringarlaan and the H.F. van Riellaan in the Tuindorp district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. This church building was opened in 1936 as a Reformed church. It was designed by architect Abraham van der Kraan. The simple nave church has a slender church tower with a tapered spire

name: Tulpbrug
en: The Tulpbrug (bridge 255) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, on the border of the districts Centrum and Oost. The bridge forms the connection between Professor Tulpplein with the Amstel Hotel and the Huddekade on the one hand and the Weesperzijde on the other. It spans the Singelgracht.

name: Tulpbrug
en: The Tulpbrug (bridge 255) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam, on the boundary of the Centrum and Oost boroughs. It links the Professor Tulpplein, with the Amstel Hotel and the Huddekade, to the Weesperzijde, spanning the Singelgracht. Its southern abutment meets the embankment of viaduct 325 and the Torontobrug.

name: Twiske
en: Twiske can refer to: The Twiske, water in North Holland The Twiske (recreation area), recreation and nature area in North Holland Twiske (school), public elementary school in Amsterdam

name: u.c.s. EDO
en: UCS EDO is a Dutch amateur football club from the city of Utrecht, founded in 1921. The club has 11 men's senior teams, 2 veteran teams and 3 women's teams. The club's first team plays in the 2nd class B(2022/2023). The club plays at Overvecht-Noord sports park in the Utrecht district of Overvecht.

name: Uilenburger Synagoge
en: The Uilenburger Synagoge or Uilenburgersjoel is a synagogue on the Nieuwe Uilenburgerstraat on the island of Uilenburg in the former Amsterdam Jewish Quarter. The synagogue was built in Louis XV style in 1766 for the Ashkenazi Jews. The progressive Jewish community Beit Ha'Chidush has been meeting there several times a month since 1997.

name: Uitdammer Die
en: The Uitdammer Die is a creek, called "die", in Waterland in North Holland. The water is located northeast of the village of Holysloot, which belongs to the municipality of Amsterdam, southeast of Broek in Waterland and southwest of Uitdam. It is a remnant of the former Waterlandse Die, a peat river in Waterland.

name: Uithoflijn
en: The Uithoflijn is a light rail line (not operated on weekends, except on FC Utrecht match days) in the city of Utrecht from Utrecht Central Station to De Uithof, the Utrecht Science Park. The route is the common part of tram lines 20, 21 and 22 in the U-OV network, with common terminal P+R Science Park, and as the other egg

name: University Library City Centre
en: The University Library Utrecht (UB Utrecht or UBU) is the library for the scientific information provision of the University of Utrecht. The library has a branch in both the city center of Utrecht and Utrecht Science Park, and smaller libraries at the faculties. The ownership of the University Library consists of about 4

name: University Library Uithof
en: The University Library Utrecht (UB Utrecht or UBU) is the library for the scientific information provision of the University of Utrecht. The library has a branch in both the city center of Utrecht and Utrecht Science Park, and smaller libraries at the faculties. The ownership of the University Library consists of about 4

name: Utrechtsch Studenten Corps
en: The Utrechtsch Studenten Corps, short for U.S.C., the oldest student association in Utrecht, was never officially founded but emerged over time. The first seed was planted in 1636 when the University was established and an automatic faculty corps and student corps were created. Often 1816 is considered the founding year, but that is in fact only the founding

name: Utrechtsebaan
en: The Utrechtsebaan is a road in The Hague. The road connects from the west to the A12 from The Hague via Utrecht to the border with Germany. The road begins on the Zuid-Hollandlaan/Benoordenhoutseweg and then runs through between the Malieveld and the Haagse Bos. The road continues between the Beatrixkwartier and the Bezuidenhout until the municipal boundary.

name: Utrechtsebrug
en: The Utrechtsebrug (bridge number 439, signed as Utrechtse Brug) is an Amsterdam bridge in Amsterdam-Zuid.

name: Utrechtseweg
en: National Highway 2 (A2/N2) is a national highway in the Netherlands and forms an important north-south connection between Amsterdam, Utrecht, 's-Hertogenbosch, Eindhoven, Maastricht and the border with Belgium. At Eijsden, the route connects to the Belgian A25 towards Liège. According to Rijkswaterstaat, the A2 has a length of 217 kilometers.

name: Vaaltbrug
en: The Vaaltbrug is a lifting bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Biltsche Grift. The Vaaltbrug is located at the mouth of the Biltsche Grift into the Stadsbuitengracht.

name: Vaanweg
en: The Vaanweg is an important highway in the Rotterdam municipality of Charlois and is an extension of the A29 motorway. The Vaanweg is an important route for traffic from and to Rotterdam-Zuid, in particular to Ahoy and the shopping center and bus station Zuidplein.

name: Vaartscherijnbrug
en: The Vaartscherijnbrug is a monumental bridge in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It spans the Vaartsche Rijn where it flows into the Stadsbuitengracht. It is a bascule bridge. Over the bridge runs an important traffic artery that crosses the Catharijnesingel and the Ledig Erf. The Vaartscherijnbrug is a municipal monument. It was built around 1931

name: Vaillantlaan
en: The Vaillantlaan is a 1.5 kilometer long avenue in The Hague. It is named after the former Hague alderman for finance and welfare Mr. Johan Pieter Vaillant. Built between 1896 and 1900, it was almost completely demolished between 1985 and 1995 and rebuilt again between 1990 and 2009 according to a master plan by architect Jo Coenen.

name: Valkenburgerstraat
en: The Valkenburgerstraat is a street in the Nieuwmarkt neighborhood in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is the main street of the former island of Valkenburg (Marken).

name: Van Alkemadelaan
en: The Van Alkemadelaan in The Hague is a district bypass road of the Benoordenhout district and is constructed for the entire length of about 3 km as a through road with four lanes, partly with separated lanes. The road is named after Dirk van Alkemade, mayor of The Hague (1560-1572). The main bypass road of the seaside resort of Scheveningen is the N440

name: Van Buurenmonument
en: The Van Buurenmonument is a memorial in Amsterdam commemorating Lucas van Buuren.

name: Van de Sande Bakhuijzenstraat
en: The Van de Sande Bakhuijzenstraat is a street in Amsterdam in the Overtoomse Veld district in the Nieuw-West district. The street connects Jan Tooropstraat with Jan van Galenstraat. The street borders GVB-Garage West.

name: Van der Kunstraat
en: The Van der Kunstraat is a relatively short street in Amsterdam-Oost, Van der Kunbuurt.

name: Van Diemenstraat
en: The Van Diemenstraat is a street in the Zeeheldenbuurt of Amsterdam-Centrum. The street, which is part of the ring road s100, begins at Barentszplein in the east and ends at the Westerkeersluisbrug bridge that spans the Westerkanaal. The Van Diemenstraat is by the way the name of more streets in the Netherlands, named after Antonio van Diemen (1593-164

name: Van Eesteren Museum
en: The Van Eesteren Museum is a museum in Amsterdam Nieuw-West devoted entirely to the architect and town planner Cornelis van Eesteren. Since 22 October 2017 it has been housed in the Van Eesteren Paviljoen at Noordzijde 31.

name: Van Gendt Hallen
en: The Hallen van Stork, Van Gendthallen or Werkspoorhallen are five interconnected halls of the former Werkspoor-Stork factory in Oostenburg in Amsterdam. The buildings are located in the southwest corner of the former factory site, bordered by the Wittenburgervaart, the Oostenburgerdwarsvaart, the Oostenburgervaart and the railway lines between Centraal Stat

name: Van Hallbrug
en: Brug 171 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It connects the Van Hallstraat with the Kostverlorenstraat, spanning the Kostverlorenvaart. That waterway is part of the Staandemastroute, so a fixed bridge is not possible here. Originally there was no intention to build a bridge at this spot.

name: Van Hallbrug
en: Bridge 171 is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It forms the connection between Van Hallstraat and Kostverlorenstraat and spans the Kostverlorenvaart. The Kostverlorenvaart is part of the Staandemast route, hence a fixed bridge is not possible here. Initially, it was not intended to build a bridge here, although

name: Van Heukelompark
en: The Van Heukelompark is a park in the Utrecht district of Zuilen. The park is named after the Utrecht architect George van Heukelom. Construction of the park began in 2012. The park still had the working name Springerpark at the time. The Van Heukelompark is a redesign of a park-like area that was known in official circles as the Van Heukelomlob.

name: Van Karnebeekbron
en: The Van Karnebeekbron is a sandstone monument that commemorates the Carnegie Foundation and the opening of the Peace Palace in The Hague on August 28, 1913. It is a bench with fountain, stands at the corner of Scheveningseweg and Carnegielaan and consists of three parts. The curved central part is higher than the two sides and has a lion's head in the middle

name: Van Kinsbergenstraat
en: The Van Kinsbergenstraat is a street in the Chassébuurt of Amsterdam-West. The name refers to the Dutch naval officer Jan Hendrik van Kinsbergen (1735-1819). The Van Kinsbergenstraat was built in the 1920s. The western end of the street comes out at a footbridge over the Admiralengracht where a café was located. The eastern end of the

name: Van Limburg Stirumplein
en: The Van Limburg Stirumplein is a square in Amsterdam-West. The square is located in the Staatsliedenbuurt, between the Van Limburg Stirumstraat and the Van der Hoopstraat. The Bentinckstraat also crosses the square.

name: Van Mierlobrug
en: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with the Herenstraat, spanning the Herengracht. It forms a whole with bridge 19, in the eastern quay of the Herengracht over the Blauwburgwal. It is surrounded by municipal and national monuments.

name: Van Mierlobrug
en: Van Mierlobrug (bridge 18) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The traffic bridge connects the southern quay of the Blauwburgwal with Herenstraat. It spans Herengracht in the process. The bridge forms a whole with bridge 19 on the eastern quay of Herengracht and over the Blauwburgwal.

name: Van Nijenrodeweg
en: The Van Nijenrodeweg is a connecting street (access road) in the Amsterdam district of Buitenveldert and was named in 1958. The street is named after Gijsbrecht II of Nijenrode, bailiff of Amstelland, Waterland and Gooiland (1357-'58). Most of the access roads that were built around 1960 in Buitenveldert are named after historical bailiffs of

name: Van Noordtgracht
en: The Van Noordtgracht is a canal in the West district of Amsterdam. The name was established by council decision of November 20, 1878. The canal is named after Olivier van Noort (1558-1627), a explorer, who was the first Dutchman to circumnavigate the world via street Magelhaens from 1598 to 1601.

name: Van Oldenbarneveltstraat
en: The Van Oldenbarneveltstraat with the Van Oldenbarneveltplaats in the extension is a street in the center of Rotterdam. The street runs from the Mauritsweg to the Coolsingel. The area west of Karel Doormanstraat is the Van Oldenbarneveltstraat and largely consists of pre-war buildings. The area east of Karel Doormanstraat is a

name: Varkenssluis
en: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in the Wallengebied area of Amsterdam. The bridge connects Damstraat with Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been lying here for centuries. It can already be seen on city maps by Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625).

name: Varkenssluis
en: The Varkenssluis (bridge no. 204) is a bridge over the Oudezijds Voorburgwal in Amsterdam's Wallen district, connecting the Damstraat with the Oude Doelenstraat. A bridge has been here for centuries, appearing on the city maps of Pieter Bast (1599) and Balthasar Florisz. van Berckenrode (1625). It is named after the pig market held here around the 16th century.

name: Vasteland
en: The Vasteland is a road south of the center of Rotterdam and is part of the Centrumring S100. The road runs along the Westzeedijk and extends to the Nieuwe Leuvebrug. Unused tram rails are located in the middle barrier of the motorway. At the corner with the Schiedamsedijk is the Maastorenflat, which was the highest building for a while after construction.

name: Vecht
en: The Weerdsluis is a sluice gate with pointed doors in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It forms the connection between the Vecht and the Stadsbuitengracht. The sluice also has a flap door that was used to spill. The waterway is CEMT class II. The lock is 95.00 m long, the width is 8.00 m, the gate length is 82.00 m and the pool is 18.00 m wide.

name: Veebrug
en: The Veebrug (bridge 261) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Lozingskanaal and lies in the Veelaan, connecting the Zeeburgerpad with the Zeeburgerdijk. The Veelaan begins at the Cruquiusweg, crosses the Nieuwe Vaart by the Slachthuisbrug, and meets the Molukkenstraat across the Lozingskanaal.

name: Veebrug
en: The Veebrug (bridge 261) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Oost. It spans the Discharge Canal and is located in the Veelaan. It provides the connection between the Zeeburgerpad and the Zeeburgerdijk. The Veelaan begins at the Cruquiusweg, crosses the Nieuwe Vaart via the Slaughterhouse Bridge and connects to the Molukkenstraat across the Discharge Canal.

name: Veenderijbrug
en: The Veenderijbrug (bridge number 639) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. The bridge is located in the Osdorperweg and spans the Osdorpervaart to the Osdorper Binnenpolder. There has been a bridge here since the 1920s, when the draining of the polder began. Initially this was a loading bridge, it was replaced in the 1940s by a boat

name: Veenderijbrug
en: The Veenderijbrug (bridge number 639) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam Nieuw-West. It lies in the Osdorperweg and spans the Osdorpervaart towards the Osdorper Binnenpolder. A bridge has been here since the 1920s, when peat extraction in the polder began; the original drawbridge was replaced by a fixed bridge in the 1940s.

name: Veeneikbrug
en: The Veeneikbrug is a cycle and foot bridge connecting the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost to the west with the Diemerbos in Diemen to the east. It crosses the provincial road N236 on the Amsterdam side, the Gaasp and Weespertrekvaart, and the Stammerdijk on the Diemen side.

name: Veeneikbrug
en: The Veeneikbrug is a bicycle and pedestrian bridge that connects pedestrians and cyclists between the Bijlmerweide in Amsterdam-Zuidoost (west) and the Diemerbos in Diemen (east). The bridge crosses the Provincial road N236 (Amsterdam side), the Gaasp/Weespertrekvaart and the Stammerdijk (Diemer side). On the Amsterdam side it connects to the Gulde

name: Veerhaven
en: The Veerhaven is one of the historic harbors in Rotterdam, located between the Willemskade and the Westerkade in the classic Shipping Quarter of Rotterdam. It is located on the north side of the Nieuwe Maas, not far from the Euromast.

name: Veilinghaven
en: The Veilinghaven (or Parkhaven) in the Dutch city of Utrecht is the former port of the Utrecht vegetable auction on the Merwedekanaal. Around this port, the eponymous residential area was developed between 1997 and 2014.

name: Ver Huellbank
en: The Ver Huellbank is a memorial bench that was established in 1881 in The Hague in memory of Mr. Henry Christiaan Arnoud Ver Huell (1820-1881).

name: Veroneseplantsoen
en: The Veroneseplantsoen is a park in Amsterdam-Zuid, Oud-Zuid, Apollobuurt. The park was named after a council decision of October 31, 2017; after the painter Paolo Veronese. It is located between Veronesestraat (north), Raphaëlstraat (west), Gerrit van der Veenstraat (south) and Michelangelostraat (east), which were already in the 1920s

name: Verversingskanaal
en: The Verversingskanaal is a canal in The Hague that until 2016 was called the Wastewater Canal or Drainage Canal. The name Verversingskanaal was also already widely used before the official name change. The canal runs from the city center along Houtrustweg, Suezkade and Conradkade.

name: Viebrug
en: The Viebrug is a arched bridge in the Utrecht city center that spans the Oudegracht. Adjacent to the bridge are connecting workshops and yards. The former main post office is located next to Viebrug. The Lange Viestraat continues over the bridge into the Potterstraat. An old mention of the Viebrug dates back to 1289.

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
en: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also known as Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a permanent bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It is located on the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. It has been a municipal monument since 1995 and is surrounded by national monuments.

name: Vier Heemskinderenbrug
en: The Vier Heemskinderenbrug, also called the Vier Heemskinderensluis, is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the western quay of the Herengracht and crosses the Leidsegracht. A municipal monument since 1995, it is surrounded by national monuments, one of which, Herengracht 394, has a wall stone under its middle first-floor window.

name: Vierhavensstraat
en: The Vierhavensstraat is a street in Nieuw-Mathenesse in Rotterdam-West, which owes its name to the four harbors whose quay borders this street. These harbors are the Koushaven, the IJselhaven, the Lekhaven and the Keilehaven. The area formed by these harbors is now also known as the Four Harbors Area. Directly to the north

name: Vierkant eiland in de plas
en: Vierkant eiland in de plas is a large monumental work of art made by artist Frans de Wit (Leiden, 1942-2004). The work of art is located in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, in the Prinsenland district. It marks the historically lowest point in the Netherlands, which is more than 7 meters below sea level. The work of art was unveiled on October 2, 1996.

name: Vierwindstrekenbrug
en: The Vierwindstrekenbrug (bridge no. 381) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-West.

name: Vikingrijn
en: The Vikingrijn is a newly excavated section of an original course of the Rhine River in the Máximapark in the municipality of Utrecht.

name: Villa Zebra
en: Villa Zebra is an art laboratory for children from 2 to 12 years old in Rotterdam. The organization develops art programs in which children are introduced to contemporary art in an accessible way. At Villa Zebra, children are encouraged to experiment, discover and express themselves in their own way. For children from 2 to

name: Vincentiuskerk
en: The Sint-Vincentiuskerk, named after patron saint Vincentius a Paulo, was a Catholic church building in Amsterdam Oud-West. The starting signal was given in July 1899 when the congregation purchased a 50 by 40 meter plot of land for a church and school.

name: Vissersmonument
en: Scheveningen has three Fishermen's Monuments. The oldest of them was unveiled on September 26, 1922 in memory of those Scheveningen fishermen who lost their lives during World War I due to war violence at sea.

name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
en: De Brakke Grond, full name Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural center at Nes 45 in Amsterdam. The current building is a design by architect Arthur Staal. De Brakke Grond, located on a square in the middle of the theater district on the Nes, offers performances in the field of performing arts, visual arts, music and other forms of art

name: Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond
en: De Brakke Grond, in full Vlaams Cultuurhuis de Brakke Grond, is a Flemish cultural centre at Nes 45 in Amsterdam. The present building was designed by the architect Arthur Staal. Standing on a small square in the middle of the theatre district on the Nes, it presents performing arts, visual arts, music and other art forms.

name: Vleutense Wetering
en: The Vleutense Wetering is a watercourse in the western part of the Dutch municipality of Utrecht that is formed by part of the old course of the Rhine River. From the 8th century until around 1935, there was an artificial watercourse between the current city center and this river course, which was also sometimes called and was also known as Vleutense.

name: Vleutensespoorbrug
en: The Vleutensespoorbrug is the northernmost of the two railway bridges that connect the city of Utrecht with the Leidsche Rijn district. The bridge spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Utrecht-Rotterdam railway line.

name: Vleutensespoorbrug 2
en: The Vleutensespoorbrug 2 is the second railway bridge next to the Vleutense railway bridge. Like the Vleutense railway bridge, the bridge spans the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal and is part of the Utrecht-Rotterdam railway line. The bridge is located between the Hogeweide Bridge and the Vleutense railway bridge, on the site of the former Vleutense Bridge.

name: Vleutenseweg
en: The Vleutenseweg is a street in the Dutch city of Utrecht, which runs from the Westplein near Utrecht Central Station, via the Hogeweidebrug over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal to the Leidsche Rijn district. Here the street connects to the Vleutensebaan.

name: Vlothaven
en: The Vlothaven is a port in the Amsterdam Western Port Area south of the Coenhaven, north of the Nieuwe Hemweg, east of the Einsteinweg and north of the Neptunushaven. The port is named after the raft. The port was dug in 1931 near the Mercuriushaven and provided space for ships and activities in the Eastern Harbor Area

name: Voetiusstraat
en: The Voetiusstraat is a street in the center of the Dutch city of Utrecht. It runs with a length of about 60 meters from the Domplein to the Pieterskerkhof. The street already existed around 1300. It was located around 1400 on the immunity of the Cathedral. Until his death in 1660, the painter Cornelis van Poelenburg lived in this then narrow alley. Ron

name: Volewijckbrug
en: The Volewijckbrug (bridge 2475) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Noord.

name: Volharding 1
en: The Volharding 1 is a steam-powered Dutch tugboat. The ship was built as Harmonie 6 at Scheepswerf de Hoop in Hardinxveld for Mr. Van Loon from Vreeswijk. He ordered the ship as a "Zeeland-type" with open bunker hatches and with the mast retractable forward. The power should have been at least 28 HP. During the trial run, it served as

name: Vollersbrug
en: The Vollersbrug is a nationally protected arched bridge in the city center of Utrecht. The bridge spans the Oudegracht and has two spans. On the bridge border are workshop basements and yards. In the past, it was also sometimes referred to as the Volders Bridge. The name of the bridge is related to the volders who lived here.

name: Vondelbrug
en: The Vondelbrug (bridge 200) is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid, connecting Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Vondelbrug
en: The Vondelbrug is a fixed bridge in the form of a viaduct in Amsterdam-Zuid and connects Amsterdam Oud-Zuid with Amsterdam Oud-West.

name: Vondellaan
en: Vondellaan can refer to: Vondellaan (Baarn) Vondellaan 53 (Baarn) Vondellaan 55 (Baarn) Vondellaan (Groningen) Vondellaan (Hilversum) Vondellaan (Leiden) Vondellaan (Utrecht)

name: Vondelmonument
en: The Vondel monument, also known as the Vondelbeeld, is a large statue of the 17th-century Dutch poet and playwright Joost van den Vondel in the Vondelpark in Amsterdam. It was unveiled on 18 October 1867, after which the park itself came to be called the Vondelpark, which became its official name in 1880.

name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
en: The Vondelpark Open Air Theatre in Amsterdam has staged concerts and performances every summer since 1974, by amateurs and professionals in cabaret, dance, children's theatre and music, in the heart of the Vondelpark. Admission is free, though a voluntary donation is requested.

name: Vondelpark Open Air Theater
en: The Vondelpark Open-Air Theater in Amsterdam has been organizing concerts and performances by amateurs and professional performers in the field of cabaret, dance, children's shows and music in the heart of Vondelpark every summer since 1974. The performances are free to attend, but a voluntary donation is requested. Every weekend in the months of June, July

name: Voorboezem
en: The Voorboezem is an old watercourse along the southern sea wall of the former island of Wieringen, near the Polder Waard-Nieuwland in Hollands Kroon in the Dutch province of North Holland.

name: Voorhaven
en: The Voorhaven is the old harbor in Rotterdam-Delfshaven. The harbor was dug in 1389 as part of the construction of the Delfshavense Schie between Overschie and the Nieuwe Maas and served as a feeder harbor for the city of Delft.

name: Voorveldse Polder
en: Park de Voorveldse Polder is a park on the northeastern edge of the city of Utrecht. The park was reclaimed in the Middle Ages at the request of Bishop Godebald and is enclosed between the A27, Biltsestraatweg (N237), Sartreweg and the Biltse Rading. In the park is Fort De Bilt, one of the defensive works of the New Holland Water Line. In the seventies

name: Vredenburgplein
en: The Vredenburg, also known as Vreeburg, is a busy square in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is also the name of the adjacent street, which connects Central Station with the old city center. The square is part of the shopping area in the center of Utrecht and borders the Hoog Catharijne shopping center. On three fixed days (Wednesday, Friday e

name: Vredeskapel
en: The Vredeskapel is a former church building of the Reformed Church in the Malakkastraat (Archipelbuurt) in the Dutch city of The Hague. Since 2018 it has been converted into four residential units.

name: Vredeskerk
en: The Parish Church of Our Lady Queen of Peace or Vredeskerk is a Roman Catholic church between Pijnackerstraat and Van Hilligaertstraat in the southwest corner of the Pijp in Amsterdam-Zuid. The church has been the namesake of Vredeskerkplein since 2004.

name: Vrijburg
en: Diepenbrockstraat 46 is a church building on Diepenbrockstraat in Amsterdam-Zuid. The side facade is on Herman Gorterstraat. Here, between 1931 and 1933, a church building was erected for the Remonstrant Reformed Church in Amsterdam.

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a clockwork toy that was manufactured in 1952 by the company A.H. van Bergen in Heiligerlee at the initiative of the Dutch Committee for National Commemoration. It hung in several places, including on the Dam in 1955. It was offered to the municipality of Amsterdam in 1960. This decided in late May of that year to c

name: Vrijheidscarillon
en: The Vrijheidscarillon in Amsterdam is a carillon made in 1952 by the firm A.H. van Bergen of Heiligerlee at the initiative of the Dutch national commemoration committee. It has hung in several places, including on the Dam in 1955, and was presented to the city of Amsterdam in 1960.

name: Vrijheidslaan
en: The Vrijheidslaan (formerly Amstellaan and Stalinlaan) is a main street in Amsterdam-Zuid, which together with the Berlagebrug forms the eastern entrance to the Rivierenbuurt. The avenue is an important main axis within the monumental urban planning Plan Zuid by architect Berlage and splits into two equal parts west of the Rijnstraat, on the Victorieplein.

name: Vrijmetselarij Museum
en: The Cultural Masonic Center 'Prince Frederick' (CMC) in The Hague, in the Dutch province of South Holland, is a museum, archive and library of the Order of Freemasons under the Grand Orient of the Netherlands. The center manages the collection that the Dutch Freemasons have brought together over nearly 250 years. The CMC can be quantified to the mi

name: Vulcaanhaven
en: The Vulcaanhaven is a private seaport on the east side of Vlaardingen on the Nieuwe Maas, between the Koningin Wilhelminahaven and Schiedam. The port was built in 1911 and was for a long time the largest private sea port in Europe. The port basin was especially important due to the transit of coal to Germany (iron industry in he

name: VVJ
en: Football club Jaffa, also known as VVJ, is a Dutch amateur football club from the city of Utrecht, founded in 1931. The club is named after the Utrecht Machinefabriek Jaffa. VVJ plays at Sportpark Overvecht-Noord in the Utrecht district of Overvecht. The club's first team plays in the Fourth Division on Saturday (season 2020/21).

name: W.H. Vliegenbos
en: The W.H. Vliegenbos is located in Amsterdam-North, between Meeuwenlaan, Nieuwendammerdijk, Nieuwendammerkade and Zamenhofstraat. It is the oldest urban forest of the municipality of Amsterdam.

name: Waalsdorperweg
en: The Waalsdorperweg is a quiet residential street in the Benoordenhout in The Hague, but was for many years from around 1975 to 2008 a busy main road to Wassenaar. As early as 1559, the Waelstorperlaen was named, it is probably named after an even older place called Walinxdorp.

name: Waalse Kerk
en: The Waalse Kerk with adjacent caretaker's house in Rotterdam is located in the Center on the Schiedamse Vest and is a national monument, the church and the caretaker's house were built in 1923-1925 in a traditionalist style, somewhat in the style of Kropholler, designed by J. Verheul Dzn. and J. van Wijngaarden.

name: Waalseilandbrug
en: Bridge 283 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge over the Waalseilandsgracht forms the connection between the Lastage or Nieuwmarktbuurt and the Waalseiland. On the northeast side are the Buiten Bantammerstraat and the Binnenkant quay.

name: Waalseilandbrug
en: Brug 283 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge over the Waalseilandsgracht connects the Lastage, or Nieuwmarkt quarter, with the Waalseiland. The Buiten Bantammerstraat and the Binnenkant quay lie to the north-east, and the Binnen Bantammerstraat and the Lastageweg to the south-west.

name: Wachterliedplantsoen
en: The Wachterliedplantsoen is a park in the Bos en Lommer district in the Amsterdam municipality of West. The park, which was established in the early 1950s, is located between Egidiusstraat (west), Reinaert de Vosstraat (north), Heer Halewijnstraat (east) and Erasmusgracht (south). There is a pedestrian bridge over the canal to Erasmus Park. In 2010 is h

name: Wagon Litsbrug
en: Bridge 387 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. The bridge spans the Open Havenfront on the west side. It allows pedestrians and cyclists to cross from the west side of Stationsplein and the eastern quay of the Westertoegang to the Prins Hendrikkade at once. On the south side she lands on the foot and bicycle path of the Prins He

name: Wagon Litsbrug
en: Brug 387 is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It spans the western side of the Open Havenfront, letting pedestrians and cyclists cross in one go from the west side of the Stationsplein and the eastern quay of the Westertoegang to the Prins Hendrikkade, landing on the south side on that street's foot and cycle path.

name: Walenweeshuissluis
en: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum; sluis here means a stone bridge. It connects the Vijzelstraat with the filled-in Vijzelgracht, crossing the Prinsengracht. The name refers to the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children of the French or Walloon church.

name: Walenweeshuissluis
en: The Walenweessluis (bridge 70) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. Sluis stands for stone bridge here. The bridge forms the connection between Vijzelstraat and the canalized Vijzelgracht. It is located over the Prinsengracht. The name Walenweessluis is a name derived from the Walenweeshuis, the orphanage for children from the French or Walloon church.

name: Walk of Fame
en: The Walk of Fame in Utrecht is located in Vinkenburgstraat in the center of Utrecht. The Walk of Fame consists of bronze plaques with hand and footprints of celebrities from the film world. The Walk of Fame originated from the Dutch Film Festival, which also takes place annually in Utrecht. Together with the awarding of the prizes, the

name: Warmoesbrug
en: Warmoesbrug may refer to the Warmoesbrug in Amsterdam, bridge 22 and a national monument, or the Warmoesbrug in Delft.

name: Wasknijper
en: De Wasknijper (bridge 177) is a drawbridge in Amsterdam-Noord. The traffic bridge lies in the Distelweg and crosses the Buiksloterkanaal. It is the northernmost bridge over that canal.

name: waterdraagster
en: Waterdraagster met vissen is an artistic work in Amsterdam-West. A classical fountain originally stood in the garden of the Bellamyplein from 1905. The garden fell into disorder and the city cleared it; the fountain made way for a paddling pool designed by Ko Mulder, where neighbourhood children could splash from late summer 1954.

name: Waterlinieweg
en: The Waterlinieweg is a road, partly uneven, in the east of the city of Utrecht. The road owes its name to its location parallel to the Lunetten on the Houtense Vlakte, part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie.

name: Wederkomst des Herenkerk
en: The Wederkomst des Herenkerk is a Roman Catholic church building on Marco Pololaan in the Kanaleneiland district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is dedicated to the Return of the Lord. The church is used by the Martinus parish.

name: Wederkomst des Herenkerk
en: The Wederkomst des Herenkerk is a Roman Catholic church building on Marco Pololaan in the Kanaleneiland district in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church is dedicated to the Return of the Lord. The church is used by the Martinus parish.

name: Weenatunnel
en: The Weenatunnel is a traffic tunnel in the center of Rotterdam, part of the Weena. The underground passage is located between Stationsplein/Kruisplein in front of Rotterdam Central Station. The tunnel is 350 meters long, and is part of the city route S100 Centrumring.

name: Weerdpoort
en: The Weerdpoort, also known as Amsterdamse Poort, was one of the four city gates of the city of Utrecht from the Middle Ages. The gate was located on the north side of the current city center, where the Oudegracht, the Stadsbuitengracht and the Utrechtse Vecht meet and today lies the Weerdbrug.

name: Weesbrug
en: The Weesbrug (formerly also Reguliersbrug) is a nationally protected arched bridge in the Utrecht city center. The bridge spans the Oudegracht. The bridge can only be used by pedestrians and cyclists. In the abutments of the bridge are bridge basements.

name: Weesperbrug
en: The Weesperbrug is a fixed steel arch bridge over the Amsterdam-Rijnkanaal and forms part of the provincial road N236.

name: Weesperplein
en: The Weesperplein is a square in the center of Amsterdam, between the Singelgracht and the Nieuwe Achtergracht. It connects the Weesperstraat via the Weesperpoortbrug to the Rhijnspoorplein in the direction of the Wibautstraat and is part of the Amsterdam city route s112, which connects the Gooiseweg to the IJtunnel.

name: Weesperstraat
en: The Weesperstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Centrum. The original buildings were demolished in the 1960s, after which the street was widened into a city highway, which connects J.D. Meijerplein with Weesperplein. The busy traffic road is part of the S112, which connects the IJtunnel and Mr. Visserplein via the Wibautstraat with the Gooiseweg. The s

name: Weespertrekvaart
en: The Weespertrekvaart is a canal that connects the Amstel in Amsterdam with the Vecht in Weesp. The canal was built in 1639, using several existing waterways: the ring canal of the Watergraafsmeer polder (constructed in 1629), the ring canal of the Bijlmermeer polder (constructed in 1626), the Gaasp river, and the ge

name: Weg der Verenigde Naties
en: The Weg der Verenigde Naties or Southern Ring Road is part of the ring road around Groningen and also part of Rijksweg 7. The road is about twelve kilometers long and runs from the Hoogkerk district to the Euvelgunne district. The road is important for the traffic flows between the city and the rest of the Netherlands but also for the passing car traffic.

name: Welplaathaven
en: The Welplaathaven is a port in the Botlek area in Rotterdam. The port is named after the former island of the Welplaat, which was buried with the eastern part of the island of Rozenburg to form the Botlek industrial area.

name: Werk aan de Hoofddijk
en: Fort Hoofddijk was built in 1877-1879 east of Utrecht as part of the Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie. As a result of advances in artillery and explosives, the fort ring built around Utrecht in the 1820s had become outdated, and a new advanced ring of f was built in the 1870s.

name: Werkhaven
en: The Werkhaven is a port in the Rotterdam port area. The port is a branch of the Nieuwe Maas on the south side of the river and is located northwest of Heijplaat. To the southwest is the Eemhaven and to the east is the Heijsehaven. North of the Werkhaven is the Quarantine Station Heijplaat.

name: Werkspoorbrug
en: The Werkspoorbrug is a railway bridge over the Amsterdam-Rhine Canal in Utrecht. The bridge is a steel-concrete arch bridge and was put into use in 2002. The span is 237 meters, making it the railway bridge with the second longest span in the Netherlands (the longest is the Zandhazenbrug near Muiderberg).

name: Wertheimpark
en: The Wertheimpark is a city park in the Plantagebuurt in Amsterdam.

name: West Indian Warehouse
en: The West Indian Warehouse in Amsterdam dates back to 1642 and is located on the western part of Rapenburg, where the Oudeschans flows into the Oosterdok. It was originally owned by the West Indian Company (WIC). The letters GWC on the facade stand for the official name, 'Geoctroyeerde West-Indische Compagnie'. Currently it has the monument status.

name: West Singelsgracht
en: The Hague canal belt is the (partly 16th and especially early) 17th-century Singelsgracht that is still intact. A belt is ring-shaped, or circular, the Singelsgracht of The Hague has a different (angular) shape. That is not unique. Old Rotterdam had a triangular shape. A canal belt should not be confused with a system of interconnected waterways.

name: Westblaak
en: The Westblaak is a wide street in the center of Rotterdam. The Westblaak connects Churchillplein with Eendrachtsplein.

name: Westelijk Marktkanaal
en: The Westelijk Marktkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam-West. The name of the canal refers to the location of the canal relative to the Central Market Halls. The canal was put into use in 1934 for the opening and supply of the Central Market Halls. Today, most transport takes place by truck. Unlike the Kostv

name: Westelijke Zijhaven 1e Petroleumhaven
en: The Eerste Petroleumhaven - until April 21, 1942 called Petroleumhaven - is a pre-war harbor in Rotterdam-Pernis. The Eerste Petroleumhaven was dug between 1929 and 1933 and designed for the supply of crude oil for the refinery of Koninklijke Olie (Shell). Shell had started at the Sluisjesdijk in the Waalhaven area.

name: Westelijke Zijhaven 2e Petroleumhaven
en: The Tweede Petroleumhaven is a port in Rotterdam-Pernis. The Tweede Petroleumhaven was dug between 1938 and 1941 and designed for the transhipment of crude oil for the refinery of Koninklijke Olie (Shell). The supply of crude oil no longer takes place in the Second Petroleumhaven, but in Europoort and on the Maasvlakte. The supply of crude oil after

name: Westerdoksdijk
en: The Westerdokseiland is an island in Amsterdam between the Westerdok and the IJ. It was created in 1832 when the Westerdoksdam was built, separating this part of the IJ and therefore no longer experiencing tides in the IJ, which was still in open connection with the Zuiderzee until 1870.

name: Westerdoksdijkspoorbrug
en: The Spoorbrug Westerdokseiland (bridge no. 19S) is a former railway bridge in Amsterdam. It connected the tracks of Centraal Station with the goods yard then on Westerdokseiland.

name: Westerdoksluis
en: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It crosses the connection between the Westerdok and the IJ, carrying the Stadsroute 100 between the Westerdokskade and De Ruijterkade on the south side and the Westerdoksdijk on Westerdokseiland to the north.

name: Westerdoksluis
en: The Westerdoksluis is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum.

name: Westergasbrug
en: The Westergasbrug (bridge 193) is an iron lifting bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is not exactly along the extension of Van Limburg Stirumstraat, on the other side of its intersection with the Haarlemmerweg. It spans the Haarlemmervaart and provides access to the grounds of the former Westergasfabriek, its namesake.

name: Westerkanaal
en: The Westerkanaal is a canal in Amsterdam that connects the Singelgracht and the Haarlemmertrekvaart to the IJ, where the ships on the north side of the canal first have to cross the Oude Houthaven. The canal runs from the Singelgrachtbrug to Tasmanstraat/Van Diemenstraat. The western quay is interrupted by the Le Mairegracht and the Va

name: Westerkanaalschutsluis
en: The Westerkanaalschutsluis is a lock in the Westerkanaal, Amsterdam-West. They are located between both Houtmankades. The original lock was built from June 1877 (date of tender) in the then newly dug Westerkanaal, which formed a continuous route between the Singelgracht and the IJ. Large ships came in, so it became a fairly large sch

name: Westerkeersluis
en: The Westerkeersluis (bridge 346) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge spans the Westerkanaal and is part of the Centrumring S100. It connects Van Diemenstraat with Tasmanstraat. North of the bridge, the wooden sluice doors of the Westerkanaal water dam (sluice 205) between the city and the IJ are visible. The northern doors of that sluice l

name: Westerkeersluis
en: The Westerkeersluis (bridge 346) is a bascule bridge in Amsterdam-West. It spans the Westerkanaal and forms part of the S100 centre ring, connecting the Van Diemenstraat with the Tasmanstraat. North of the bridge stand the wooden gates of the Westerkanaal flood barrier (lock 205) between the city and the IJ.

name: Westerpark
en: The Westerpark is a park in Amsterdam-West, west of the Haarlemmerpoort and north of the Haarlemmertrekvaart.

name: Westertoegang
en: Westertoegang is a short canal (canal) in Amsterdam, between the IJ and the Singel.

name: Westertoren
en: The Westertoren in Amsterdam is the tower of the Westerkerk, at Prinsengracht 279 by the Westermarkt in Amsterdam-Centrum. The tower is owned by the city of Amsterdam. It was restored from February 2023 until early 2025.

name: Westerwijk
en: Westerwijk or Wester-wijk is a building in Amsterdam with houses, office space and two rooms. The building was built after a tender in June 1925 in 1925/1926 on the Admiraal de Ruyterweg to the design of F.B. Jantzen in the style of the Amsterdam School. The construction cost amounted to just under 80,000 guilders at the time.

name: Westhaven
en: The Westhaven is a port in the Western Port Area in Amsterdam and was built as part of the General Expansion Plan of 1934. The port is located west of the former Hembrug, on the south side of the North Sea Canal, in the former Groote IJpolder. The first part was dug in 1937 and was then called 'Fordhaven', after the nearby

name: Westkanaaldijk
en: Westkanaaldijk is a district in the north of the Lindenholt district in the Dutch city of Nijmegen. On January 1, 2023, the district had 5 residents, distributed over 5 houses, on an area of 1.22 km².

name: Westlandgracht
en: The Westlandgracht is a surface water, a street and until 1962 the name of a district and is named after the Westland, the area west of Delft and south of The Hague. The streets in the neighborhood are also named after places and regions in South Holland. The canal was named in 1933 and was built in the 1920s on the territory of the in

name: Westlandgrachtsluis
en: The Westlandgrachtsluit, also known as Westlandgrachtsluis, is a sluice gate in Overtoomse Veld in Amsterdam Nieuw-West.

name: Westplein
en: Westplein can refer to:"Westplein", the former name of the "Heroes of the Seaport Square" in Den Helder, renamed after the establishment of a monument for Dorus Rijkers after 1928. Westplein (Rotterdam), a square near the Veerhaven in the Shipping Quarter in Rotterdam. Westplein (Utrecht), a traffic square on the west side of Utrecht Central Station.

name: Westplein
en: The Westplein is a traffic square on the west side of Utrecht Central Station.

name: Westpoortweg
en: The Westpoortweg is an important continuous connection between Amsterdam Westpoort and the North Sea Canal and further towards Velsen-Zuid. The road extends from Luvernes but is in fact the extension of the North Sea Road which at the junction with Luvernes makes a right turn and then again a left turn. The road continues in an S-shape along d

name: Westzeedijk
en: The Westzeedijk is part of Schielands Hoge Zeedijk, the dike that was built in the 13th century to protect the area between Gouda, Leiden and Rotterdam from flooding. The name of the dike comes from its location west of the old town of Rotterdam. It is also the name of the street that runs over the dike. Tram line 8 runs over the Westzeedijk. it

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Weteringpoort was one of the eight Amsterdam city gates built during the third and fourth expansions. Part of the city's fortifications, it was, with the Raampoort and the Zaagmolenpoort, one of the smaller gates. Besides a passage with a wooden bridge it also had a waterway opening connecting the Lijnbaansgracht.

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Weteringpoort was one of the eight Amsterdam city gates that were built during the third and fourth explanations. The Weteringpoort, which was part of the fortifications of Amsterdam, was one of the smaller city gates together with the Raampoort and Zaagmolenpoort.

name: Weteringpoort
en: The Water Management Lock (lock 209) is a lock in the center of Amsterdam between Lijnbaansgracht and Singelgracht. The lock dates back to 1657 when two passages into the city were built in the Schans; the other was the Leidsepoortsluis (demolished in 1880).

name: Wethouder Frankeweg
en: Wethouder Frankeweg is a street in Amsterdam-Oost.

name: Wezenbrug
en: The Wezenbrug (formerly called the Weezenbrug before the war) is a permanent bridge over the Steigersgracht in the Dutch city of Rotterdam. The original bridge is named after the users of the oldest known orphanage in the pre-war Hoogstraat and probably existed since the fifteenth century. The original Weezenbrug was probably demolished and replaced in 1942

name: Wezerhaven
en: The Wezerhaven is a small docking port in Rotterdam's Europoort on the Caland Canal. Exxon Mobil Chemical Holland is located on the south side of the port and Caldic Chemie on the west side.

name: Wibautstraat
en: The Wibautstraat is a street in Amsterdam-Oost, between the Rhijnspoorplein and the Prins Bernhardplein and named after former alderman Floor Wibaut.

name: Wiegbrug
en: The Wiegbrug (bridge no. 173) is a movable bridge over the Kostverlorenvaart in Amsterdam-West, connecting the De Clercqstraat with the Admiraal de Ruijterweg. Its name refers to the type of bridge built here in 1904, a rolling bascule bridge.

name: Wijkerbrug
en: The Wijkerbrug in the Dutch town of Voorburg is a lift bridge over the Vliet dating back to 1891. During construction, the bridge was built as a fixed bridge. In 1919, the bridge was converted into a lift bridge. The bridge is a national monument.

name: Wijnhaven
en: The Wijnhaven is a harbor in the center of Rotterdam. The Wijnhaven is connected to the Oude Haven and the Leuvehaven. On the Wijnhaven stand the White House and the Marine Museum. The André van der Louw Bridge runs over the Wijnhaven. On the harbor are the Maasboulevard, Boompjes, Wijnhavenpunt, Scheepsmakerskade and the Wijnkade.

name: Wijttenbachstraat
en: The Wijttenbachstraat is a street in the Dapperbuurt in Amsterdam-Oost, between the corner Oosterpark-Linnaeusstraat and the railway viaduct near Pontanusstraat. The street was laid out in the 1880s and was named in 1882, after the eighteenth-century professor Daniël Wyttenbach. The first houses in the street were built for the officers in the nearby

name: Wil de Graaffbrug
en: The Wil de Graaffbrug (bridge 393) is a pedestrian bridge in Amsterdam-West. The bridge is located in the northeast of Erasmus Park and spans the Erasmusgracht, which is just outside the park. The bridge extends from the Lof der zotheid bridge (bridge 394). The bridge dates back to 1970, when the park was completely redesigned for a lot of money at the time.

name: Wil de Graaffbrug
en: The Wil de Graaffbrug (bridge 393) is a footbridge in Amsterdam-West. It lies in the north-east of the Erasmuspark and spans the Erasmusgracht, which runs just outside the park, in line with the Lof der zotheidbrug (bridge 394). It dates from 1970, when the park was completely relaid at what was then great expense.

name: Wilhelmina
en: The statue of Queen Wilhelmina, near the Euromast in the Dutch city of Rotterdam, is a work of art by Charlotte van Pallandt. It was made on commission from a Rotterdam committee, led by K.P. van der Mandele, to commemorate the woman who had given the war-torn city so much support. The stone monument

name: Wilhelminafontein
en: The Wilhelminafontein in Rotterdam is a monumental fountain on the Noordereiland on Burgemeester Hoffmanplein. The monument was erected in 1898 on the occasion of the inauguration of Queen Wilhelmina. It is a design by Prof. Dr. Henri Evers, the architect of the Rotterdam town hall. The images on the monument are by Simon Mied

name: Wilhelminahaven
en: The Wilhelminahaven in the Dutch municipality of Schiedam is a port that was built between 1914 and 1921 on the northern side of the Nieuwe Maas. The port is located west of Vijfsluizen (Wiltonhaven), and east of the Spuihaven in Schiedam-Zuid.

name: Wilhelminakade
en: The Wilhelminakade is a street on the left bank of the Maas in Rotterdam. It has a rich history and in the first years of the 21st century there was much talk of high-rise buildings being built.

name: Wilhelminakerk
en: The Wilhelminakerk is a church building in the Dutch city of Utrecht. The church building was built around 1931 in the Schildersbuurt on the corner of Hobbemastraat and Paulus Potterstraat. The design in the style of the Amsterdam School comes from the architect H.F. Mertens. The building is valued as a municipal monument.

name: Wilhelminapark
en: The Wilhelminapark is a city park in the Dutch city of Utrecht. It is recognized as a national monument as one of the first parks in the Netherlands. The park is centrally located in Utrecht-Oost and east of Oudwijk. The surrounding neighborhood is called the Wilhelminaparkbuurt while a street along the park is also called Wilhelminapark.

name: Willem de Zwijgerkerk
en: The Willem de Zwijgerkerk is a Protestant church on Olympiaweg in Amsterdam-Zuid. It is a "neighborhood church" of the Protestant Church (PKN) in Amsterdam.

name: Willemsbrug
en: The Willemsbrug (bridge 151) is a bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Singelgracht between the Haarlemmerplein and the Nassauplein. This bascule bridge is named after the nearby Willemspoort. The construction of a bridge at this location became necessary after the construction of the Westerkanaal in 1877.

name: Willemsbrug
en: The Willemsbrug (bridge 151) is a bridge in Amsterdam-West over the Singelgracht between the Haarlemmerplein and the Nassauplein. This bascule bridge is named after the nearby Willemspoort. A bridge became necessary here after the Westerkanaal was dug in 1877. The present bridge is a 1925 design by Piet Kramer, built in 1928.

name: Willemsbrug
en: The Willemsbrug is a bridge over the Nieuwe Maas in the center of the Dutch city of Rotterdam.

name: Willibrorduskapel
en: The Willibrorduskapel is a Catholic chapel in The Hague, located on the first floor of the Willibrordushuis at Oude Molstraat 35. The chapel is a municipal monument and was built in 1928 in the style of the Delft School, designed by the Hague architect Jos Duynstee, for the Sisters of Love from Tilburg. The complex of which the chapel is the

name: Wiltonhaven
en: The Wiltonhaven is a port in Schiedam on the Nieuwe Maas. Wilton-Fijenoord was based in this port, which was completed in 1924. In 2003, Damen took over this shipyard and it is now called Damen Shiprepair Rotterdam. North of it is the site of Huisman, while Mammoet has its headquarters on the west side of the port in the Vijfsluizerhaven.

name: Wim Sonneveldbrug
en: The Wim Sonneveldbrug (bridge 175) is a fixed bridge in Amsterdam-Centrum. It lies in the Marnixstraat and spans the Leidsegracht. It was placed in 1935/1936 to a plain design by Piet Kramer, with no ornament or sculpture.

name: Wim Suurbierbrug
en: The Wim Suurbierbrug (bridge 2239) is a structural work of art in Amsterdam-Oost.
